text:
Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke asmanon aur zameen ki har ek cheez Allah Ta'ala ki tasbeeh, taqdees, tamjeed, takbeer, tauheed mein mashghool hai, jaise aur jagah farman hai: (Wa in min shai'in illa yusabbihu bihamdihi wa lakin la tafqohuna tasbeehahum, innahu kana haleeman ghafoora) (Al-Isra: 44). Yaani har cheez Allah Ta'ala ki pakeezgi aur sana khwani karti hai, woh ghalba wala aur buland janab wala aur aali sarkar wala hai aur apne tamam ahkaam-o-farman mein hikmat wala hai. 

Jis ne Ahl-e-Kitab ke kafiron yaani qabeela Bani Nazeer ke yahudiyon ko unke gharon se nikala, iska mukhtasar qissa yeh hai ke Madina mein aa kar Huzoor ﷺ ne in yahudiyon se sulh kar li thi ke na aap in se ladein na yeh aap se ladein, lekin in logon ne is ahd ko tod diya jin ki wajah se Allah ka ghazab un par nazil hua, Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi ﷺ ko un par ghalib kiya aur aap ne unhein yahan se nikal diya. 

Musalmanon ko kabhi iska khayal tak na tha, khud yeh yahud bhi samajh rahe the ke in mazboot qilon ke hote hue koi unka kuch nahi bigad sakta, lekin jab Allah ki pakad aayi yeh sab cheezein yunhi rakhi ki rakhi reh gayi aur achanak is tarah girift mein aa gaye ke hairan reh gaye aur aap ne unhein Madina se nikalwa diya. Baaz toh Sham ki zaraati zameenon mein chale gaye jo hashar-o-nashar ki jagah hai aur baaz Khaibar ki taraf ja nikle. Un se keh diya gaya tha ke apne unton par lad kar jo le ja sako apne sath le jao, isliye unhone apne gharon ko tod phod kar jo cheezein le ja sakte the apne sath utha lein, jo reh gayi woh Musalmanon ke hath lagin. 

Is waqya ko bayan kar ke farmata hai ke Allah ke aur uske Rasool ﷺ ke mukhalifin ka anjam dekho aur is se ibrat hasil karo ke kis tarah un par azab-e-ilahi achanak aapada aur duniya mein bhi tabaah-o-barbaad kiye gaye aur akhirat mein bhi zaleel-o-ruswa ho gaye aur dardnak azab mein ja pade.

Abu Dawood mein hai ke Ibn Ubayy aur uske mushrik sathiyon ko jo qabeela Aus-o-Khazraj mein se thay, kuffar-e-Quresh ne khat likha. Yeh khat unhein Huzoor ﷺ ke maidan-e-Badr se wapas lautne se pehle mil gaya tha. Is mein tehreer tha ke tum ne Huzoor ﷺ ko apne shehar mein thehraya hai, pas ya toh tum us se ladai karo aur use nikaal kar baahar karo ya hum tumhein nikaal dein ge aur apne tamam lashkaroun ko le kar tum par hamla karein ge aur tumhare tamam ladne walon ko hum teh-tegh kar dein ge aur tumhari aurton ladkiyon ko loundiyan bana lein ge. Allah ki qasam yeh ho kar hi rahega, ab tum soch samajh lo. 

Abdullah bin Ubayy aur uske but-parast sathiyon ne is khat ko pa kar aapas mein mashwara kiya aur khufiya taur par Huzoor ﷺ se ladai karne ki tajweez bil-ittifaq manzoor kar li. Jab Huzoor ﷺ ko yeh khabrein maaloom huin toh aap khud un ke pas gaye aur un se farmaya ke mujhe maaloom hua hai ke Quraishiyon ka khat kaam kar gaya aur tum log apni mout ke saaman apne haathon karne lage ho, tum apni aulaadon aur apne bhaiyon ko apne haathon zibah karna chahte ho, main tumhein phir ek martaba moqa deta hoon ke soch samajh lo aur apne is bad-iraday se baaz aao. 

Huzoor ﷺ ke is irshad ne un par asar kiya aur woh log apni apni jagah chale gaye lekin Quresh ne Badr se farigh ho kar unhein phir ek khat likha aur isi tarah dhamkaya. Unhein un ki quwat, un ki tadad aur un ke mazboot qilay yaad dilaye magar yeh phir akad mein aa gaye aur Banu Nazir ne saf taur par bad-ahdi par kamar bandh li aur Huzoor ﷺ ke pas qasid bheja ke aap tees aadmi le kar aaiye, hum mein se bhi tees zil-ilm aadmi aate hain, hamare tumhare darmiyan ki jagah par yeh saath aadmi milein aur aapas mein baat-cheet ho, agar yeh log aap ko sacha maan lein aur iman le aayein toh hum bhi aap ke sath hain.

Is bad-ahdi ki wajah se doosre din subh Rasool Allah ﷺ ne apna lashkar le ja kar un ka mohasra kar liya aur un se farmaya ke ab agar tum naye sire se amn-o-aman ka ahd-o-paiman karo to khair warna tumhein amn nahi, unhon ne saaf inkaar kar diya aur larne marne par tayyar ho gaye, chunacha din bhar larhai hoti rahi, doosri subh ko Aap Bani Quraiza ki taraf lashkar le kar barhe aur Bani Nazir ko yunhi chhora, un se bhi yahi farmaya ke tum naye sire se ahd-o-paiman karo, unhon ne manzoor kar liya aur moahda ho gaya, Aap wahan se farig ho kar phir Bani Nazir ke paas aaye, larhai shuru hui, akhir yeh hare aur Huzoor ﷺ ne unhein hukm diya ke tum Madina khali kar do, jo asbab le jana chaho aur oonton par lad kar le jao, chunacha unhon ne ghar baar ka asbab yahan tak ke darwaze aur lakdiyan bhi oonton par ladin aur jala-watan ho gaye, un ke khajooron ke darakht khas-tah Rasool Allah ﷺ ke ho gaye, Allah Ta'ala ne yeh Aap ko hi dilwa diye, jaise aayat (Wama afa'allahu 'ala rasulihi minhum fama awjaftum 'alaihi min khailin wa la rikaibin wa lakinnallaha yusallitu rusulahu 'ala man yasha'u, wallahu 'ala kulli shayin qadir) (Al-Hashr: 6) mein hai, lekin An-Hazrat ﷺ ne aksar hissa Muhajirin ko de diya, wahan Ansarion mein se sirf do hi hajatmandon ko hissa diya, baqi sab Muhajirin mein taqseem kar diya. Taqseem ke baad jo baqi reh gaya tha, yahi woh maal tha jo Rasool Allah ﷺ ka sadqa tha aur jo Bani Fatima ke haath laga. Ghazwa-e-Bani Nazir ka mukhtasar qissa aur sabab yeh hai ke mushrikon ne dhokha bazi se Sahaba-e-Karam ko Bi'r Ma'una mein shaheed kar diya, un ki tadad sattar thi, un mein se ek Hazrat 'Amr bin Umayyah Zamri ؓ bach kar bhaag nikle, Madina Sharif ki taraf aaye, aate aate moqa pa kar unhon ne Qabila Bani 'Amir ke do shakhson ko qatal kar diya, halanke yeh qabila Rasool Allah ﷺ se moahda kar chuka tha aur Aap ne unhein amn-o-aman de rakha tha, lekin is ki khabar Hazrat 'Amr ko na thi, jab yeh Madine pahuche aur Huzoor ﷺ se zikr kiya to Aap ne farmaya tum ne unhein qatal kar dala, ab mujhe un ke warison ko diyat yaani jurmana-e-qatal ada karna parega, Bani Nazir aur Bani 'Amir mein bhi half-o-aqd aur aapas mein masalihat thi, is liye Huzoor ﷺ un ki taraf chale taake kuch yeh dein, kuch Aap dein aur Bani 'Amir ko razi kar liya jaye. Qabila Bani Nazir ki garhi Madina ke mashriq ki janib kayi meel ke fasle par thi, jab Aap yahan pahuche to unhon ne kaha haan Huzoor ﷺ hum mein mojood hain, abhi abhi jama kar ke apne hisse ke mutabiq Aap ki khidmat mein hazir karte hain, idhar Aap se hat kar yeh log aapas mein mashwara karne lage ke is se behtar moqa kab haath lage ga.

Is waqt aap qabze mein hain aao kaam tamam kar dalo, chunacha yeh mashwara huwa ki jis deewar se aap lage baithe hain us ghar par koi chadh jaye aur wahan se bada sa patthar Aap ﷺ par phenk de ki Aap ﷺ dab jayein, Amr bin Mujash bin Kaab is kaam par muqarrar huwa us ne aap ki jaan lene ka beeda uthaya aur chhat par chadh gaya chahta tha ki patthar ludhka de itne mein Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Jibreel A.S ko Huzoor ﷺ ke paas bheja aur hukm diya ki aap yahan se uth khade hon chunacha aap foran hat gaye aur yeh bad-batin apne bure irade mein nakaam rahe. Aap ke sath us waqt chand sahaba the mislan Hazrat Abu Bakar Siddique R.A, Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A, Hazrat Ali R.A waghera aap yahan se foran Madina Sharif ki taraf chal pade, idhar jo sahaba aap ke sath na the aur Madina mein aap ke muntazir the unhein dair lagne ke baais khayal huwa aur woh aap ko dhoondne ke liye nikal khade hue lekin ek shakhs se maloom huwa ki aap Madina Sharif pahunch gaye hain chunacha yeh log wahin aaye poochha ki Huzoor ﷺ kya waqiya hai ? Aap ne sara qissa keh sunaya aur hukm diya ki jihad ki taiyari karo mujahideen ne kamrein baandh liin aur Allah ki rah mein nikal khade hue. Yahoodiyon ne lashkaron ko dekh kar apne qile ke phatak band kar diye aur panah-guzin ho gaye aap ne muhasra kar liya phir hukm diya ki unke khajoor ke darakht jo aas-paas hain woh kaat diye jayein aur jala diye jayein, ab to yahood cheekhne lage ki yeh kya ho raha hai ? Aap to zameen mein fasaad karne se auron ko rokte the aur fasadiyon ko bura kehte the phir yeh kya hone laga ? Pas idhar to darakht katne ka gham, idhar jo kumak aane wali thi us ki taraf se mayusi in dono cheezon ne in yahoodiyon ki kamar tod di.

Kumak ka waqiah yeh hai ke Banu Awf bin Khazraj ka qabila jis mein Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul aur Wadiah bin Malik, Ibn Abu Qauqal aur Suwaid aur Dais waghairah thay un logon ne Banu Nazir ko kahla bheja tha ke tum muqablay par jamey raho aur qila khali na karo hum tumhari madad par hain tumhara dushman hamara dushman hai hum tumhare sath mil kar is se larenge aur agar tum niklay toh hum bhi niklenge, lekin ab tak un ka yeh wada pura na hua aur unhon ne yahudiyon ki koi madad na ki, idhar un ke dil maroub hogaye toh unhon ne darkhwast ki ke ya Rasulallah (ﷺ) hamari jan-bakhshi kijiye hum Madina chor jatay hain lekin hum apna jo maal oonton par lad kar le jasakein woh humein de diya jaye Aap (ﷺ) ne un par raham kha kar un ki yeh darkhwast manzoor farma li aur yeh log yahan se chalay gaye jatay waqt apnay darwazon tak ko ukhaar kar le gaye gharon ko gira gaye aur Sham aur Khaibar mein ja kar abad hogaye, un ke baqi ke ahl-e-khaas Rasulallah (ﷺ) ke hogaye ke Aap jis tarah chahhein unhein kharch karein chunancha Aap (ﷺ) ne Muhajireen-e-Awwaleen ko yeh maal taqseem kardiya, haan Ansar mein se sirf do shakhson ko yani Sahl bin Hunaif aur Abu Dujana Simak bin Kharsha ko diya is liye ke yeh dono hazrat masakeen thay, Banu Nazir mein se sirf do shakhs musalman hue jin ke maal unhi ke paas rahay ek toh Yamin bin Umair jo Amr bin Hajjash ke chacha ke larkay ka larka tha yeh Amr woh hai jis ne Huzoor (ﷺ) par patthar phenknay ka bera uthaya tha, doosray Abu Saad bin Wahab aik martaba Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Yamin se farmaya ke hey Yamin teray is chacha zad bhai ne dekh toh meray sath kis qadar bura bartao barta aur mujhay nuqsaan pohnchanay ki kis bebaki se koshish ki ? Hazrat Yamin ne aik shakhs ko kuch dena kar ke Amr ko qatl kara diya, Surah Hashr isi waqiah Banu Nazir ke baray mein utri hai, Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmatay hain jisay is mein shaq ho ke Mahshar ki zameen Sham ka mulk hai woh is ayat ko parh lay, in yahudiyon se jab Rasulallah (ﷺ) ne farmaya ke tum yahan se nikal jao toh unhon ne kaha hum kahan jayen ?

Aap ne farmaya mahshar ki zameen ki taraf, Hazrat Hasan farmate hain ke jab Huzoor ﷺ ne Bani Nazir ko jala watan kiya toh farmaya yeh awal hashar hai aur hum bhi uske peechhe hi peechhe hain (Ibn Jareer). Bani Nazir ke un qilon ka muhasra sirf chhe roz raha tha, muhasireen ko qile ki mazbooti, yahudiyon ki ziyadati, yakjehti, munafiqeen ki sazishen aur khufiya chaalen waghera dekh kar hargiza yeh yaqeen na tha ke is qadar jald yeh qila khaali kar denge. Idhar khud yahud bhi apne qile ki mazbooti par nazan the aur jaante the ke woh har tarah mehfooz hain, lekin Amr-e-Ilahi aisi jagah se aa gaya jo un ke khayal mein bhi na thi. Yahi dastoor Allah ka hai ke makkar apni makkari hi mein rehte hain aur be-khabar par azaab-e-ilahi aa jata hai. Un ke dilon mein raub chha gaya, bhala raub kyun na chhata, muhasra karne wale woh the jinhe Allah ki taraf se raub diya gaya tha ke dushman maheena bhar ki raah par ho aur wahin uska dil dehalne laga tha, Salawatullahi wa Salamuhu Alaih. 

Yahudi apne haathon apne gharon ko barbaad karne lage, chhaton ki lakdi aur darwaze le jaane ke liye todne phodne shuru kar diye. Muqatil farmate hain musalmanon ne bhi un ke ghar tode, is tarah ke jaise jaise aage badhte gaye, un ke jo jo makaanat waghera qabze mein aate gaye, maidan kushaada karne ke liye unhe dhate gaye. Isi tarah khud yahud bhi apne makaano ko aage se toh mehfooz karte jaate the aur peechhe se naqb laga kar nikalne ke raaste banate jaate the. Phir farmata hai, Ae aankhon walo! Ibrat hasil karo aur us Allah se daro jis ki laathi mein awaaz nahi. Agar un yahudiyon ke muqaddar mein jala watani na hoti toh unhe is se bhi sakht azaab diya jata, yeh qatal hote aur qaid kar liye jaate waghera waghera, phir aakhirat ke badtareen azaab bhi un ke liye taiyar hain. 

Bani Nazir ki yeh ladai Jang-e-Badr ke chhe mah baad hui, maal jo oonton par lad jayein unhe le jaane ki ijazat thi magar hathiyar le jaane ki ijazat na thi. Yeh us qabeele ke log the jinhe is se pehle kabhi jala watani hui hi na thi. Ba-qaul Hazrat Urwah bin Zubair shuru surat se fasiqeen tak aayatein isi waqie ke bayaan mein nazil hui hain. Jala ke maane qatal-o-fana ke bhi kiye gaye hain, Huzoor ﷺ ne unhe jala watani ke waqt teen teen mein ek ek oont aur ek ek mashk di thi. Is faisle ke baad bhi Huzoor ﷺ ne Muhammad bin Maslamah ؓ ko un ke paas bheja tha aur unhe ijazat di thi ke teen din mein apna saamaan theek kar ke chale aayein. Is duniyawi azaab ke sath hi ukhrawi azaab ka bhi bayaan ho raha hai ke wahan bhi un ke liye hatmi aur lazmi taur par Jahannam ki aag hai.

Un ki is dargat ki asli wajah yeh hai ke unhon ne Allah Ta'ala ka aur Uske Rasool ﷺ ka khilaf kiya aur ek اعتبار (itibar) se tamam nabiyon ko jhutlaya is liye ke har nabi ne Aap ki babat pesh goi ki thi, yeh log Aap ko poori tarah jaante thay balki aulad ko unka baap jis qadar pehchanta hai is se bhi zyada yeh log Nabi Akhiruz-Zaman ko jaante thay lekin taham sarkashi aur hasad ki wajah se maane nahi, balki muqabale par tul gaye aur yeh zahir baat hai ke Allah Ta'ala bhi apne mukhalifon par sakht azab nazil farmata hai. Linah kehte hain achhi khajuroon ke darakhton ko ajwa aur barfi jo khajur ki qismein hain baqoul ba'az woh linah mein dakhil nahi aur baqoul ba'az sirf ajwa nahi aur baqoul ba'az har qism ki khajurein is mein dakhil hain jin mein buwairah bhi dakhil hai, yahudiyon ne jo ba-taur taana ke kaha tha ke khajuroon ke darakht katwa kar apne qoul ke khilaf fa'il kar ke zameen mein fasad kyun phailate hain? Yeh is ka jawab hai ke jo kuch ho raha hai woh hukm-e-Rab se aur ijazat-e-Allah se dushmanan-e-Allah ko zaleel o nakaam karne aur unhe past o badnaseeb karne ke liye ho raha hai jo darakht baqi rakhe jayen woh ijazat se aur jo kaate jaate hain woh bhi maslihat ke sath, yeh bhi marwi hai ke ba'az muhajireen ne ba'az ko un darakhton ke kaatne se mana kiya tha ke aakhir-kar to yeh musalmanon ko ba-taur maal-e-ghanimat milne wale hain phir unhe kyun kaata jaye? Jis par yeh aayat utri ke rokne wale bhi haq ba-janib hain aur kaatne wale bhi bar-haq hain un ki niyat musalmanon ke nafe ki hai aur un ki niyat kafiron ko ghaiz o ghazab mein lane aur unhe un ki shararat ka maza chakhane ki hai, aur yeh bhi irada hai ke is se jal kar woh ghusse mein phir kar maidan mein ayen toh phir do do haath hojayen aur aada-e-Deen ko kifar-e-kirdar tak pohncha diya jaye, sahaba ne yeh fa'il kar toh liya phir dare ke aisa na ho kaatne mein ya baqi chhorne mein Allah ki taraf se koi muakhza ho toh unhon ne Huzoor ﷺ se poocha aur yeh aayat nazil hui. Yaani dono baaton par ajr hai kaatne par bhi aur chhorne par bhi, ba'az riwayaton mein hai katwaye bhi thay aur jalwaye bhi thay. Banu Quraiza ke yahudiyon par is waqt Huzoor ﷺ ne ehsan kiya aur unko Madina Sharif mein hi rehne diya lekin bil-akhir jab yeh bhi muqabale par aaye aur munh ki khai toh unke larne wale mard toh qatal kiye gaye aur auratein, bachche aur maal musalmanon mein taqseem kar diye gaye haan jo log Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hogaye aur iman laye woh bach rahe, phir Madina se tamam yahudiyon ko nikaal diya Banu Qainqa' ko bhi jin mein se Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam R.A thay aur Banu Haritha ko bhi aur kul yahudiyon ko jala-watan kiya. In tamam waqeat ko arab shairon ne apne ash'ar mein bhi nihayat khoobi se ada kiya hai, jo Seerat Ibn Ishaq mein marwi hai yeh waqia baqoul Ibn Ishaq ke Uhad aur Bir Ma'unah ke baad ka hai aur baqoul Urwah Badr ke chheh mahine baad ka hai wallahu a'lam.

Is bad-ahdi ki wajah se doosre din subh Rasool Allah ﷺ ne apna lashkar le ja kar un ka mohasra kar liya aur un se farmaya ke ab agar tum naye sire se amn-o-aman ka ahd-o-paiman karo to khair warna tumhein amn nahi, unhon ne saaf inkaar kar diya aur larne marne par tayyar ho gaye, chunacha din bhar larhai hoti rahi, doosri subh ko Aap Bani Quraiza ki taraf lashkar le kar barhe aur Bani Nazir ko yunhi chhora, un se bhi yahi farmaya ke tum naye sire se ahd-o-paiman karo, unhon ne manzoor kar liya aur moahda ho gaya, Aap wahan se farig ho kar phir Bani Nazir ke paas aaye, larhai shuru hui, akhir yeh hare aur Huzoor ﷺ ne unhein hukm diya ke tum Madina khali kar do, jo asbab le jana chaho aur oonton par lad kar le jao, chunacha unhon ne ghar baar ka asbab yahan tak ke darwaze aur lakdiyan bhi oonton par ladin aur jala-watan ho gaye, un ke khajooron ke darakht khas-tah Rasool Allah ﷺ ke ho gaye, Allah Ta'ala ne yeh Aap ko hi dilwa diye, jaise aayat (Wama afa'allahu 'ala rasulihi minhum fama awjaftum 'alaihi min khailin wa la rikaibin wa lakinnallaha yusallitu rusulahu 'ala man yasha'u, wallahu 'ala kulli shayin qadir) (Al-Hashr: 6) mein hai, lekin An-Hazrat ﷺ ne aksar hissa Muhajirin ko de diya, wahan Ansarion mein se sirf do hi hajatmandon ko hissa diya, baqi sab Muhajirin mein taqseem kar diya. Taqseem ke baad jo baqi reh gaya tha, yahi woh maal tha jo Rasool Allah ﷺ ka sadqa tha aur jo Bani Fatima ke haath laga. Ghazwa-e-Bani Nazir ka mukhtasar qissa aur sabab yeh hai ke mushrikon ne dhokha bazi se Sahaba-e-Karam ko Bi'r Ma'una mein shaheed kar diya, un ki tadad sattar thi, un mein se ek Hazrat 'Amr bin Umayyah Zamri ؓ bach kar bhaag nikle, Madina Sharif ki taraf aaye, aate aate moqa pa kar unhon ne Qabila Bani 'Amir ke do shakhson ko qatal kar diya, halanke yeh qabila Rasool Allah ﷺ se moahda kar chuka tha aur Aap ne unhein amn-o-aman de rakha tha, lekin is ki khabar Hazrat 'Amr ko na thi, jab yeh Madine pahuche aur Huzoor ﷺ se zikr kiya to Aap ne farmaya tum ne unhein qatal kar dala, ab mujhe un ke warison ko diyat yaani jurmana-e-qatal ada karna parega, Bani Nazir aur Bani 'Amir mein bhi half-o-aqd aur aapas mein masalihat thi, is liye Huzoor ﷺ un ki taraf chale taake kuch yeh dein, kuch Aap dein aur Bani 'Amir ko razi kar liya jaye. Qabila Bani Nazir ki garhi Madina ke mashriq ki janib kayi meel ke fasle par thi, jab Aap yahan pahuche to unhon ne kaha haan Huzoor ﷺ hum mein mojood hain, abhi abhi jama kar ke apne hisse ke mutabiq Aap ki khidmat mein hazir karte hain, idhar Aap se hat kar yeh log aapas mein mashwara karne lage ke is se behtar moqa kab haath lage ga.

Is waqt aap qabze mein hain aao kaam tamam kar dalo, chunacha yeh mashwara huwa ki jis deewar se aap lage baithe hain us ghar par koi chadh jaye aur wahan se bada sa patthar Aap ﷺ par phenk de ki Aap ﷺ dab jayein, Amr bin Mujash bin Kaab is kaam par muqarrar huwa us ne aap ki jaan lene ka beeda uthaya aur chhat par chadh gaya chahta tha ki patthar ludhka de itne mein Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Jibreel A.S ko Huzoor ﷺ ke paas bheja aur hukm diya ki aap yahan se uth khade hon chunacha aap foran hat gaye aur yeh bad-batin apne bure irade mein nakaam rahe. Aap ke sath us waqt chand sahaba the mislan Hazrat Abu Bakar Siddique R.A, Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A, Hazrat Ali R.A waghera aap yahan se foran Madina Sharif ki taraf chal pade, idhar jo sahaba aap ke sath na the aur Madina mein aap ke muntazir the unhein dair lagne ke baais khayal huwa aur woh aap ko dhoondne ke liye nikal khade hue lekin ek shakhs se maloom huwa ki aap Madina Sharif pahunch gaye hain chunacha yeh log wahin aaye poochha ki Huzoor ﷺ kya waqiya hai ? Aap ne sara qissa keh sunaya aur hukm diya ki jihad ki taiyari karo mujahideen ne kamrein baandh liin aur Allah ki rah mein nikal khade hue. Yahoodiyon ne lashkaron ko dekh kar apne qile ke phatak band kar diye aur panah-guzin ho gaye aap ne muhasra kar liya phir hukm diya ki unke khajoor ke darakht jo aas-paas hain woh kaat diye jayein aur jala diye jayein, ab to yahood cheekhne lage ki yeh kya ho raha hai ? Aap to zameen mein fasaad karne se auron ko rokte the aur fasadiyon ko bura kehte the phir yeh kya hone laga ? Pas idhar to darakht katne ka gham, idhar jo kumak aane wali thi us ki taraf se mayusi in dono cheezon ne in yahoodiyon ki kamar tod di.

Kumak ka waqiah yeh hai ke Banu Awf bin Khazraj ka qabila jis mein Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul aur Wadiah bin Malik, Ibn Abu Qauqal aur Suwaid aur Dais waghairah thay un logon ne Banu Nazir ko kahla bheja tha ke tum muqablay par jamey raho aur qila khali na karo hum tumhari madad par hain tumhara dushman hamara dushman hai hum tumhare sath mil kar is se larenge aur agar tum niklay toh hum bhi niklenge, lekin ab tak un ka yeh wada pura na hua aur unhon ne yahudiyon ki koi madad na ki, idhar un ke dil maroub hogaye toh unhon ne darkhwast ki ke ya Rasulallah (ﷺ) hamari jan-bakhshi kijiye hum Madina chor jatay hain lekin hum apna jo maal oonton par lad kar le jasakein woh humein de diya jaye Aap (ﷺ) ne un par raham kha kar un ki yeh darkhwast manzoor farma li aur yeh log yahan se chalay gaye jatay waqt apnay darwazon tak ko ukhaar kar le gaye gharon ko gira gaye aur Sham aur Khaibar mein ja kar abad hogaye, un ke baqi ke ahl-e-khaas Rasulallah (ﷺ) ke hogaye ke Aap jis tarah chahhein unhein kharch karein chunancha Aap (ﷺ) ne Muhajireen-e-Awwaleen ko yeh maal taqseem kardiya, haan Ansar mein se sirf do shakhson ko yani Sahl bin Hunaif aur Abu Dujana Simak bin Kharsha ko diya is liye ke yeh dono hazrat masakeen thay, Banu Nazir mein se sirf do shakhs musalman hue jin ke maal unhi ke paas rahay ek toh Yamin bin Umair jo Amr bin Hajjash ke chacha ke larkay ka larka tha yeh Amr woh hai jis ne Huzoor (ﷺ) par patthar phenknay ka bera uthaya tha, doosray Abu Saad bin Wahab aik martaba Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Yamin se farmaya ke hey Yamin teray is chacha zad bhai ne dekh toh meray sath kis qadar bura bartao barta aur mujhay nuqsaan pohnchanay ki kis bebaki se koshish ki ? Hazrat Yamin ne aik shakhs ko kuch dena kar ke Amr ko qatl kara diya, Surah Hashr isi waqiah Banu Nazir ke baray mein utri hai, Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmatay hain jisay is mein shaq ho ke Mahshar ki zameen Sham ka mulk hai woh is ayat ko parh lay, in yahudiyon se jab Rasulallah (ﷺ) ne farmaya ke tum yahan se nikal jao toh unhon ne kaha hum kahan jayen ?

Aap ne farmaya mahshar ki zameen ki taraf, Hazrat Hasan farmate hain ke jab Huzoor ﷺ ne Bani Nazir ko jala watan kiya toh farmaya yeh awal hashar hai aur hum bhi uske peechhe hi peechhe hain (Ibn Jareer). Bani Nazir ke un qilon ka muhasra sirf chhe roz raha tha, muhasireen ko qile ki mazbooti, yahudiyon ki ziyadati, yakjehti, munafiqeen ki sazishen aur khufiya chaalen waghera dekh kar hargiza yeh yaqeen na tha ke is qadar jald yeh qila khaali kar denge. Idhar khud yahud bhi apne qile ki mazbooti par nazan the aur jaante the ke woh har tarah mehfooz hain, lekin Amr-e-Ilahi aisi jagah se aa gaya jo un ke khayal mein bhi na thi. Yahi dastoor Allah ka hai ke makkar apni makkari hi mein rehte hain aur be-khabar par azaab-e-ilahi aa jata hai. Un ke dilon mein raub chha gaya, bhala raub kyun na chhata, muhasra karne wale woh the jinhe Allah ki taraf se raub diya gaya tha ke dushman maheena bhar ki raah par ho aur wahin uska dil dehalne laga tha, Salawatullahi wa Salamuhu Alaih. 

Yahudi apne haathon apne gharon ko barbaad karne lage, chhaton ki lakdi aur darwaze le jaane ke liye todne phodne shuru kar diye. Muqatil farmate hain musalmanon ne bhi un ke ghar tode, is tarah ke jaise jaise aage badhte gaye, un ke jo jo makaanat waghera qabze mein aate gaye, maidan kushaada karne ke liye unhe dhate gaye. Isi tarah khud yahud bhi apne makaano ko aage se toh mehfooz karte jaate the aur peechhe se naqb laga kar nikalne ke raaste banate jaate the. Phir farmata hai, Ae aankhon walo! Ibrat hasil karo aur us Allah se daro jis ki laathi mein awaaz nahi. Agar un yahudiyon ke muqaddar mein jala watani na hoti toh unhe is se bhi sakht azaab diya jata, yeh qatal hote aur qaid kar liye jaate waghera waghera, phir aakhirat ke badtareen azaab bhi un ke liye taiyar hain. 

Bani Nazir ki yeh ladai Jang-e-Badr ke chhe mah baad hui, maal jo oonton par lad jayein unhe le jaane ki ijazat thi magar hathiyar le jaane ki ijazat na thi. Yeh us qabeele ke log the jinhe is se pehle kabhi jala watani hui hi na thi. Ba-qaul Hazrat Urwah bin Zubair shuru surat se fasiqeen tak aayatein isi waqie ke bayaan mein nazil hui hain. Jala ke maane qatal-o-fana ke bhi kiye gaye hain, Huzoor ﷺ ne unhe jala watani ke waqt teen teen mein ek ek oont aur ek ek mashk di thi. Is faisle ke baad bhi Huzoor ﷺ ne Muhammad bin Maslamah ؓ ko un ke paas bheja tha aur unhe ijazat di thi ke teen din mein apna saamaan theek kar ke chale aayein. Is duniyawi azaab ke sath hi ukhrawi azaab ka bhi bayaan ho raha hai ke wahan bhi un ke liye hatmi aur lazmi taur par Jahannam ki aag hai.

Un ki is dargat ki asli wajah yeh hai ke unhon ne Allah Ta'ala ka aur Uske Rasool ﷺ ka khilaf kiya aur ek اعتبار (itibar) se tamam nabiyon ko jhutlaya is liye ke har nabi ne Aap ki babat pesh goi ki thi, yeh log Aap ko poori tarah jaante thay balki aulad ko unka baap jis qadar pehchanta hai is se bhi zyada yeh log Nabi Akhiruz-Zaman ko jaante thay lekin taham sarkashi aur hasad ki wajah se maane nahi, balki muqabale par tul gaye aur yeh zahir baat hai ke Allah Ta'ala bhi apne mukhalifon par sakht azab nazil farmata hai. Linah kehte hain achhi khajuroon ke darakhton ko ajwa aur barfi jo khajur ki qismein hain baqoul ba'az woh linah mein dakhil nahi aur baqoul ba'az sirf ajwa nahi aur baqoul ba'az har qism ki khajurein is mein dakhil hain jin mein buwairah bhi dakhil hai, yahudiyon ne jo ba-taur taana ke kaha tha ke khajuroon ke darakht katwa kar apne qoul ke khilaf fa'il kar ke zameen mein fasad kyun phailate hain? Yeh is ka jawab hai ke jo kuch ho raha hai woh hukm-e-Rab se aur ijazat-e-Allah se dushmanan-e-Allah ko zaleel o nakaam karne aur unhe past o badnaseeb karne ke liye ho raha hai jo darakht baqi rakhe jayen woh ijazat se aur jo kaate jaate hain woh bhi maslihat ke sath, yeh bhi marwi hai ke ba'az muhajireen ne ba'az ko un darakhton ke kaatne se mana kiya tha ke aakhir-kar to yeh musalmanon ko ba-taur maal-e-ghanimat milne wale hain phir unhe kyun kaata jaye? Jis par yeh aayat utri ke rokne wale bhi haq ba-janib hain aur kaatne wale bhi bar-haq hain un ki niyat musalmanon ke nafe ki hai aur un ki niyat kafiron ko ghaiz o ghazab mein lane aur unhe un ki shararat ka maza chakhane ki hai, aur yeh bhi irada hai ke is se jal kar woh ghusse mein phir kar maidan mein ayen toh phir do do haath hojayen aur aada-e-Deen ko kifar-e-kirdar tak pohncha diya jaye, sahaba ne yeh fa'il kar toh liya phir dare ke aisa na ho kaatne mein ya baqi chhorne mein Allah ki taraf se koi muakhza ho toh unhon ne Huzoor ﷺ se poocha aur yeh aayat nazil hui. Yaani dono baaton par ajr hai kaatne par bhi aur chhorne par bhi, ba'az riwayaton mein hai katwaye bhi thay aur jalwaye bhi thay. Banu Quraiza ke yahudiyon par is waqt Huzoor ﷺ ne ehsan kiya aur unko Madina Sharif mein hi rehne diya lekin bil-akhir jab yeh bhi muqabale par aaye aur munh ki khai toh unke larne wale mard toh qatal kiye gaye aur auratein, bachche aur maal musalmanon mein taqseem kar diye gaye haan jo log Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hogaye aur iman laye woh bach rahe, phir Madina se tamam yahudiyon ko nikaal diya Banu Qainqa' ko bhi jin mein se Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam R.A thay aur Banu Haritha ko bhi aur kul yahudiyon ko jala-watan kiya. In tamam waqeat ko arab shairon ne apne ash'ar mein bhi nihayat khoobi se ada kiya hai, jo Seerat Ibn Ishaq mein marwi hai yeh waqia baqoul Ibn Ishaq ke Uhad aur Bir Ma'unah ke baad ka hai aur baqoul Urwah Badr ke chheh mahine baad ka hai wallahu a'lam.

Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke asmanon aur zameen ki har ek cheez Allah Ta'ala ki tasbeeh, taqdees, tamjeed, takbeer, tauheed mein mashghool hai, jaise aur jagah farman hai: (Wa in min shai'in illa yusabbihu bihamdihi wa lakin la tafqohuna tasbeehahum, innahu kana haleeman ghafoora) (Al-Isra: 44). Yaani har cheez Allah Ta'ala ki pakeezgi aur sana khwani karti hai, woh ghalba wala aur buland janab wala aur aali sarkar wala hai aur apne tamam ahkaam-o-farman mein hikmat wala hai. 

Jis ne Ahl-e-Kitab ke kafiron yaani qabeela Bani Nazeer ke yahudiyon ko unke gharon se nikala, iska mukhtasar qissa yeh hai ke Madina mein aa kar Huzoor ﷺ ne in yahudiyon se sulh kar li thi ke na aap in se ladein na yeh aap se ladein, lekin in logon ne is ahd ko tod diya jin ki wajah se Allah ka ghazab un par nazil hua, Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi ﷺ ko un par ghalib kiya aur aap ne unhein yahan se nikal diya. 

Musalmanon ko kabhi iska khayal tak na tha, khud yeh yahud bhi samajh rahe the ke in mazboot qilon ke hote hue koi unka kuch nahi bigad sakta, lekin jab Allah ki pakad aayi yeh sab cheezein yunhi rakhi ki rakhi reh gayi aur achanak is tarah girift mein aa gaye ke hairan reh gaye aur aap ne unhein Madina se nikalwa diya. Baaz toh Sham ki zaraati zameenon mein chale gaye jo hashar-o-nashar ki jagah hai aur baaz Khaibar ki taraf ja nikle. Un se keh diya gaya tha ke apne unton par lad kar jo le ja sako apne sath le jao, isliye unhone apne gharon ko tod phod kar jo cheezein le ja sakte the apne sath utha lein, jo reh gayi woh Musalmanon ke hath lagin. 

Is waqya ko bayan kar ke farmata hai ke Allah ke aur uske Rasool ﷺ ke mukhalifin ka anjam dekho aur is se ibrat hasil karo ke kis tarah un par azab-e-ilahi achanak aapada aur duniya mein bhi tabaah-o-barbaad kiye gaye aur akhirat mein bhi zaleel-o-ruswa ho gaye aur dardnak azab mein ja pade.

Abu Dawood mein hai ke Ibn Ubayy aur uske mushrik sathiyon ko jo qabeela Aus-o-Khazraj mein se thay, kuffar-e-Quresh ne khat likha. Yeh khat unhein Huzoor ﷺ ke maidan-e-Badr se wapas lautne se pehle mil gaya tha. Is mein tehreer tha ke tum ne Huzoor ﷺ ko apne shehar mein thehraya hai, pas ya toh tum us se ladai karo aur use nikaal kar baahar karo ya hum tumhein nikaal dein ge aur apne tamam lashkaroun ko le kar tum par hamla karein ge aur tumhare tamam ladne walon ko hum teh-tegh kar dein ge aur tumhari aurton ladkiyon ko loundiyan bana lein ge. Allah ki qasam yeh ho kar hi rahega, ab tum soch samajh lo. 

Abdullah bin Ubayy aur uske but-parast sathiyon ne is khat ko pa kar aapas mein mashwara kiya aur khufiya taur par Huzoor ﷺ se ladai karne ki tajweez bil-ittifaq manzoor kar li. Jab Huzoor ﷺ ko yeh khabrein maaloom huin toh aap khud un ke pas gaye aur un se farmaya ke mujhe maaloom hua hai ke Quraishiyon ka khat kaam kar gaya aur tum log apni mout ke saaman apne haathon karne lage ho, tum apni aulaadon aur apne bhaiyon ko apne haathon zibah karna chahte ho, main tumhein phir ek martaba moqa deta hoon ke soch samajh lo aur apne is bad-iraday se baaz aao.

Kumak ka waqiah yeh hai ke Banu Awf bin Khazraj ka qabila jis mein Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul aur Wadiah bin Malik, Ibn Abu Qauqal aur Suwaid aur Dais waghairah thay un logon ne Banu Nazir ko kahla bheja tha ke tum muqablay par jamey raho aur qila khali na karo hum tumhari madad par hain tumhara dushman hamara dushman hai hum tumhare sath mil kar is se larenge aur agar tum niklay toh hum bhi niklenge, lekin ab tak un ka yeh wada pura na hua aur unhon ne yahudiyon ki koi madad na ki, idhar un ke dil maroub hogaye toh unhon ne darkhwast ki ke ya Rasulallah (ﷺ) hamari jan-bakhshi kijiye hum Madina chor jatay hain lekin hum apna jo maal oonton par lad kar le jasakein woh humein de diya jaye Aap (ﷺ) ne un par raham kha kar un ki yeh darkhwast manzoor farma li aur yeh log yahan se chalay gaye jatay waqt apnay darwazon tak ko ukhaar kar le gaye gharon ko gira gaye aur Sham aur Khaibar mein ja kar abad hogaye, un ke baqi ke ahl-e-khaas Rasulallah (ﷺ) ke hogaye ke Aap jis tarah chahhein unhein kharch karein chunancha Aap (ﷺ) ne Muhajireen-e-Awwaleen ko yeh maal taqseem kardiya, haan Ansar mein se sirf do shakhson ko yani Sahl bin Hunaif aur Abu Dujana Simak bin Kharsha ko diya is liye ke yeh dono hazrat masakeen thay, Banu Nazir mein se sirf do shakhs musalman hue jin ke maal unhi ke paas rahay ek toh Yamin bin Umair jo Amr bin Hajjash ke chacha ke larkay ka larka tha yeh Amr woh hai jis ne Huzoor (ﷺ) par patthar phenknay ka bera uthaya tha, doosray Abu Saad bin Wahab aik martaba Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Yamin se farmaya ke hey Yamin teray is chacha zad bhai ne dekh toh meray sath kis qadar bura bartao barta aur mujhay nuqsaan pohnchanay ki kis bebaki se koshish ki ? Hazrat Yamin ne aik shakhs ko kuch dena kar ke Amr ko qatl kara diya, Surah Hashr isi waqiah Banu Nazir ke baray mein utri hai, Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmatay hain jisay is mein shaq ho ke Mahshar ki zameen Sham ka mulk hai woh is ayat ko parh lay, in yahudiyon se jab Rasulallah (ﷺ) ne farmaya ke tum yahan se nikal jao toh unhon ne kaha hum kahan jayen ?

Aap ne farmaya mahshar ki zameen ki taraf, Hazrat Hasan farmate hain ke jab Huzoor ﷺ ne Bani Nazir ko jala watan kiya toh farmaya yeh awal hashar hai aur hum bhi uske peechhe hi peechhe hain (Ibn Jareer). Bani Nazir ke un qilon ka muhasra sirf chhe roz raha tha, muhasireen ko qile ki mazbooti, yahudiyon ki ziyadati, yakjehti, munafiqeen ki sazishen aur khufiya chaalen waghera dekh kar hargiza yeh yaqeen na tha ke is qadar jald yeh qila khaali kar denge. Idhar khud yahud bhi apne qile ki mazbooti par nazan the aur jaante the ke woh har tarah mehfooz hain, lekin Amr-e-Ilahi aisi jagah se aa gaya jo un ke khayal mein bhi na thi. Yahi dastoor Allah ka hai ke makkar apni makkari hi mein rehte hain aur be-khabar par azaab-e-ilahi aa jata hai. Un ke dilon mein raub chha gaya, bhala raub kyun na chhata, muhasra karne wale woh the jinhe Allah ki taraf se raub diya gaya tha ke dushman maheena bhar ki raah par ho aur wahin uska dil dehalne laga tha, Salawatullahi wa Salamuhu Alaih. 

Yahudi apne haathon apne gharon ko barbaad karne lage, chhaton ki lakdi aur darwaze le jaane ke liye todne phodne shuru kar diye. Muqatil farmate hain musalmanon ne bhi un ke ghar tode, is tarah ke jaise jaise aage badhte gaye, un ke jo jo makaanat waghera qabze mein aate gaye, maidan kushaada karne ke liye unhe dhate gaye. Isi tarah khud yahud bhi apne makaano ko aage se toh mehfooz karte jaate the aur peechhe se naqb laga kar nikalne ke raaste banate jaate the. Phir farmata hai, Ae aankhon walo! Ibrat hasil karo aur us Allah se daro jis ki laathi mein awaaz nahi. Agar un yahudiyon ke muqaddar mein jala watani na hoti toh unhe is se bhi sakht azaab diya jata, yeh qatal hote aur qaid kar liye jaate waghera waghera, phir aakhirat ke badtareen azaab bhi un ke liye taiyar hain. 

Bani Nazir ki yeh ladai Jang-e-Badr ke chhe mah baad hui, maal jo oonton par lad jayein unhe le jaane ki ijazat thi magar hathiyar le jaane ki ijazat na thi. Yeh us qabeele ke log the jinhe is se pehle kabhi jala watani hui hi na thi. Ba-qaul Hazrat Urwah bin Zubair shuru surat se fasiqeen tak aayatein isi waqie ke bayaan mein nazil hui hain. Jala ke maane qatal-o-fana ke bhi kiye gaye hain, Huzoor ﷺ ne unhe jala watani ke waqt teen teen mein ek ek oont aur ek ek mashk di thi. Is faisle ke baad bhi Huzoor ﷺ ne Muhammad bin Maslamah ؓ ko un ke paas bheja tha aur unhe ijazat di thi ke teen din mein apna saamaan theek kar ke chale aayein. Is duniyawi azaab ke sath hi ukhrawi azaab ka bhi bayaan ho raha hai ke wahan bhi un ke liye hatmi aur lazmi taur par Jahannam ki aag hai.

Un ki is dargat ki asli wajah yeh hai ke unhon ne Allah Ta'ala ka aur Uske Rasool ﷺ ka khilaf kiya aur ek اعتبار (itibar) se tamam nabiyon ko jhutlaya is liye ke har nabi ne Aap ki babat pesh goi ki thi, yeh log Aap ko poori tarah jaante thay balki aulad ko unka baap jis qadar pehchanta hai is se bhi zyada yeh log Nabi Akhiruz-Zaman ko jaante thay lekin taham sarkashi aur hasad ki wajah se maane nahi, balki muqabale par tul gaye aur yeh zahir baat hai ke Allah Ta'ala bhi apne mukhalifon par sakht azab nazil farmata hai. Linah kehte hain achhi khajuroon ke darakhton ko ajwa aur barfi jo khajur ki qismein hain baqoul ba'az woh linah mein dakhil nahi aur baqoul ba'az sirf ajwa nahi aur baqoul ba'az har qism ki khajurein is mein dakhil hain jin mein buwairah bhi dakhil hai, yahudiyon ne jo ba-taur taana ke kaha tha ke khajuroon ke darakht katwa kar apne qoul ke khilaf fa'il kar ke zameen mein fasad kyun phailate hain? Yeh is ka jawab hai ke jo kuch ho raha hai woh hukm-e-Rab se aur ijazat-e-Allah se dushmanan-e-Allah ko zaleel o nakaam karne aur unhe past o badnaseeb karne ke liye ho raha hai jo darakht baqi rakhe jayen woh ijazat se aur jo kaate jaate hain woh bhi maslihat ke sath, yeh bhi marwi hai ke ba'az muhajireen ne ba'az ko un darakhton ke kaatne se mana kiya tha ke aakhir-kar to yeh musalmanon ko ba-taur maal-e-ghanimat milne wale hain phir unhe kyun kaata jaye? Jis par yeh aayat utri ke rokne wale bhi haq ba-janib hain aur kaatne wale bhi bar-haq hain un ki niyat musalmanon ke nafe ki hai aur un ki niyat kafiron ko ghaiz o ghazab mein lane aur unhe un ki shararat ka maza chakhane ki hai, aur yeh bhi irada hai ke is se jal kar woh ghusse mein phir kar maidan mein ayen toh phir do do haath hojayen aur aada-e-Deen ko kifar-e-kirdar tak pohncha diya jaye, sahaba ne yeh fa'il kar toh liya phir dare ke aisa na ho kaatne mein ya baqi chhorne mein Allah ki taraf se koi muakhza ho toh unhon ne Huzoor ﷺ se poocha aur yeh aayat nazil hui. Yaani dono baaton par ajr hai kaatne par bhi aur chhorne par bhi, ba'az riwayaton mein hai katwaye bhi thay aur jalwaye bhi thay. Banu Quraiza ke yahudiyon par is waqt Huzoor ﷺ ne ehsan kiya aur unko Madina Sharif mein hi rehne diya lekin bil-akhir jab yeh bhi muqabale par aaye aur munh ki khai toh unke larne wale mard toh qatal kiye gaye aur auratein, bachche aur maal musalmanon mein taqseem kar diye gaye haan jo log Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hogaye aur iman laye woh bach rahe, phir Madina se tamam yahudiyon ko nikaal diya Banu Qainqa' ko bhi jin mein se Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam R.A thay aur Banu Haritha ko bhi aur kul yahudiyon ko jala-watan kiya. In tamam waqeat ko arab shairon ne apne ash'ar mein bhi nihayat khoobi se ada kiya hai, jo Seerat Ibn Ishaq mein marwi hai yeh waqia baqoul Ibn Ishaq ke Uhad aur Bir Ma'unah ke baad ka hai aur baqoul Urwah Badr ke chheh mahine baad ka hai wallahu a'lam.

Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke asmanon aur zameen ki har ek cheez Allah Ta'ala ki tasbeeh, taqdees, tamjeed, takbeer, tauheed mein mashghool hai, jaise aur jagah farman hai: (Wa in min shai'in illa yusabbihu bihamdihi wa lakin la tafqohuna tasbeehahum, innahu kana haleeman ghafoora) (Al-Isra: 44). Yaani har cheez Allah Ta'ala ki pakeezgi aur sana khwani karti hai, woh ghalba wala aur buland janab wala aur aali sarkar wala hai aur apne tamam ahkaam-o-farman mein hikmat wala hai. 

Jis ne Ahl-e-Kitab ke kafiron yaani qabeela Bani Nazeer ke yahudiyon ko unke gharon se nikala, iska mukhtasar qissa yeh hai ke Madina mein aa kar Huzoor ﷺ ne in yahudiyon se sulh kar li thi ke na aap in se ladein na yeh aap se ladein, lekin in logon ne is ahd ko tod diya jin ki wajah se Allah ka ghazab un par nazil hua, Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi ﷺ ko un par ghalib kiya aur aap ne unhein yahan se nikal diya. 

Musalmanon ko kabhi iska khayal tak na tha, khud yeh yahud bhi samajh rahe the ke in mazboot qilon ke hote hue koi unka kuch nahi bigad sakta, lekin jab Allah ki pakad aayi yeh sab cheezein yunhi rakhi ki rakhi reh gayi aur achanak is tarah girift mein aa gaye ke hairan reh gaye aur aap ne unhein Madina se nikalwa diya. Baaz toh Sham ki zaraati zameenon mein chale gaye jo hashar-o-nashar ki jagah hai aur baaz Khaibar ki taraf ja nikle. Un se keh diya gaya tha ke apne unton par lad kar jo le ja sako apne sath le jao, isliye unhone apne gharon ko tod phod kar jo cheezein le ja sakte the apne sath utha lein, jo reh gayi woh Musalmanon ke hath lagin. 

Is waqya ko bayan kar ke farmata hai ke Allah ke aur uske Rasool ﷺ ke mukhalifin ka anjam dekho aur is se ibrat hasil karo ke kis tarah un par azab-e-ilahi achanak aapada aur duniya mein bhi tabaah-o-barbaad kiye gaye aur akhirat mein bhi zaleel-o-ruswa ho gaye aur dardnak azab mein ja pade.

Abu Dawood mein hai ke Ibn Ubayy aur uske mushrik sathiyon ko jo qabeela Aus-o-Khazraj mein se thay, kuffar-e-Quresh ne khat likha. Yeh khat unhein Huzoor ﷺ ke maidan-e-Badr se wapas lautne se pehle mil gaya tha. Is mein tehreer tha ke tum ne Huzoor ﷺ ko apne shehar mein thehraya hai, pas ya toh tum us se ladai karo aur use nikaal kar baahar karo ya hum tumhein nikaal dein ge aur apne tamam lashkaroun ko le kar tum par hamla karein ge aur tumhare tamam ladne walon ko hum teh-tegh kar dein ge aur tumhari aurton ladkiyon ko loundiyan bana lein ge. Allah ki qasam yeh ho kar hi rahega, ab tum soch samajh lo. 

Abdullah bin Ubayy aur uske but-parast sathiyon ne is khat ko pa kar aapas mein mashwara kiya aur khufiya taur par Huzoor ﷺ se ladai karne ki tajweez bil-ittifaq manzoor kar li. Jab Huzoor ﷺ ko yeh khabrein maaloom huin toh aap khud un ke pas gaye aur un se farmaya ke mujhe maaloom hua hai ke Quraishiyon ka khat kaam kar gaya aur tum log apni mout ke saaman apne haathon karne lage ho, tum apni aulaadon aur apne bhaiyon ko apne haathon zibah karna chahte ho, main tumhein phir ek martaba moqa deta hoon ke soch samajh lo aur apne is bad-iraday se baaz aao. 

Huzoor ﷺ ke is irshad ne un par asar kiya aur woh log apni apni jagah chale gaye lekin Quresh ne Badr se farigh ho kar unhein phir ek khat likha aur isi tarah dhamkaya. Unhein un ki quwat, un ki tadad aur un ke mazboot qilay yaad dilaye magar yeh phir akad mein aa gaye aur Banu Nazir ne saf taur par bad-ahdi par kamar bandh li aur Huzoor ﷺ ke pas qasid bheja ke aap tees aadmi le kar aaiye, hum mein se bhi tees zil-ilm aadmi aate hain, hamare tumhare darmiyan ki jagah par yeh saath aadmi milein aur aapas mein baat-cheet ho, agar yeh log aap ko sacha maan lein aur iman le aayein toh hum bhi aap ke sath hain.

Is bad-ahdi ki wajah se doosre din subh Rasool Allah ﷺ ne apna lashkar le ja kar un ka mohasra kar liya aur un se farmaya ke ab agar tum naye sire se amn-o-aman ka ahd-o-paiman karo to khair warna tumhein amn nahi, unhon ne saaf inkaar kar diya aur larne marne par tayyar ho gaye, chunacha din bhar larhai hoti rahi, doosri subh ko Aap Bani Quraiza ki taraf lashkar le kar barhe aur Bani Nazir ko yunhi chhora, un se bhi yahi farmaya ke tum naye sire se ahd-o-paiman karo, unhon ne manzoor kar liya aur moahda ho gaya, Aap wahan se farig ho kar phir Bani Nazir ke paas aaye, larhai shuru hui, akhir yeh hare aur Huzoor ﷺ ne unhein hukm diya ke tum Madina khali kar do, jo asbab le jana chaho aur oonton par lad kar le jao, chunacha unhon ne ghar baar ka asbab yahan tak ke darwaze aur lakdiyan bhi oonton par ladin aur jala-watan ho gaye, un ke khajooron ke darakht khas-tah Rasool Allah ﷺ ke ho gaye, Allah Ta'ala ne yeh Aap ko hi dilwa diye, jaise aayat (Wama afa'allahu 'ala rasulihi minhum fama awjaftum 'alaihi min khailin wa la rikaibin wa lakinnallaha yusallitu rusulahu 'ala man yasha'u, wallahu 'ala kulli shayin qadir) (Al-Hashr: 6) mein hai, lekin An-Hazrat ﷺ ne aksar hissa Muhajirin ko de diya, wahan Ansarion mein se sirf do hi hajatmandon ko hissa diya, baqi sab Muhajirin mein taqseem kar diya. Taqseem ke baad jo baqi reh gaya tha, yahi woh maal tha jo Rasool Allah ﷺ ka sadqa tha aur jo Bani Fatima ke haath laga. Ghazwa-e-Bani Nazir ka mukhtasar qissa aur sabab yeh hai ke mushrikon ne dhokha bazi se Sahaba-e-Karam ko Bi'r Ma'una mein shaheed kar diya, un ki tadad sattar thi, un mein se ek Hazrat 'Amr bin Umayyah Zamri ؓ bach kar bhaag nikle, Madina Sharif ki taraf aaye, aate aate moqa pa kar unhon ne Qabila Bani 'Amir ke do shakhson ko qatal kar diya, halanke yeh qabila Rasool Allah ﷺ se moahda kar chuka tha aur Aap ne unhein amn-o-aman de rakha tha, lekin is ki khabar Hazrat 'Amr ko na thi, jab yeh Madine pahuche aur Huzoor ﷺ se zikr kiya to Aap ne farmaya tum ne unhein qatal kar dala, ab mujhe un ke warison ko diyat yaani jurmana-e-qatal ada karna parega, Bani Nazir aur Bani 'Amir mein bhi half-o-aqd aur aapas mein masalihat thi, is liye Huzoor ﷺ un ki taraf chale taake kuch yeh dein, kuch Aap dein aur Bani 'Amir ko razi kar liya jaye. Qabila Bani Nazir ki garhi Madina ke mashriq ki janib kayi meel ke fasle par thi, jab Aap yahan pahuche to unhon ne kaha haan Huzoor ﷺ hum mein mojood hain, abhi abhi jama kar ke apne hisse ke mutabiq Aap ki khidmat mein hazir karte hain, idhar Aap se hat kar yeh log aapas mein mashwara karne lage ke is se behtar moqa kab haath lage ga.

Is waqt aap qabze mein hain aao kaam tamam kar dalo, chunacha yeh mashwara huwa ki jis deewar se aap lage baithe hain us ghar par koi chadh jaye aur wahan se bada sa patthar Aap ﷺ par phenk de ki Aap ﷺ dab jayein, Amr bin Mujash bin Kaab is kaam par muqarrar huwa us ne aap ki jaan lene ka beeda uthaya aur chhat par chadh gaya chahta tha ki patthar ludhka de itne mein Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Jibreel A.S ko Huzoor ﷺ ke paas bheja aur hukm diya ki aap yahan se uth khade hon chunacha aap foran hat gaye aur yeh bad-batin apne bure irade mein nakaam rahe. Aap ke sath us waqt chand sahaba the mislan Hazrat Abu Bakar Siddique R.A, Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A, Hazrat Ali R.A waghera aap yahan se foran Madina Sharif ki taraf chal pade, idhar jo sahaba aap ke sath na the aur Madina mein aap ke muntazir the unhein dair lagne ke baais khayal huwa aur woh aap ko dhoondne ke liye nikal khade hue lekin ek shakhs se maloom huwa ki aap Madina Sharif pahunch gaye hain chunacha yeh log wahin aaye poochha ki Huzoor ﷺ kya waqiya hai ? Aap ne sara qissa keh sunaya aur hukm diya ki jihad ki taiyari karo mujahideen ne kamrein baandh liin aur Allah ki rah mein nikal khade hue. Yahoodiyon ne lashkaron ko dekh kar apne qile ke phatak band kar diye aur panah-guzin ho gaye aap ne muhasra kar liya phir hukm diya ki unke khajoor ke darakht jo aas-paas hain woh kaat diye jayein aur jala diye jayein, ab to yahood cheekhne lage ki yeh kya ho raha hai ? Aap to zameen mein fasaad karne se auron ko rokte the aur fasadiyon ko bura kehte the phir yeh kya hone laga ? Un ki is dargat ki asli wajah yeh hai ke unhon ne Allah Ta'ala ka aur Uske Rasool ﷺ ka khilaf kiya aur ek اعتبار (itibar) se tamam nabiyon ko jhutlaya is liye ke har nabi ne Aap ki babat pesh goi ki thi, yeh log Aap ko poori tarah jaante thay balki aulad ko unka baap jis qadar pehchanta hai is se bhi zyada yeh log Nabi Akhiruz-Zaman ko jaante thay lekin taham sarkashi aur hasad ki wajah se maane nahi, balki muqabale par tul gaye aur yeh zahir baat hai ke Allah Ta'ala bhi apne mukhalifon par sakht azab nazil farmata hai. Linah kehte hain achhi khajuroon ke darakhton ko ajwa aur barfi jo khajur ki qismein hain baqoul ba'az woh linah mein dakhil nahi aur baqoul ba'az sirf ajwa nahi aur baqoul ba'az har qism ki khajurein is mein dakhil hain jin mein buwairah bhi dakhil hai, yahudiyon ne jo ba-taur taana ke kaha tha ke khajuroon ke darakht katwa kar apne qoul ke khilaf fa'il kar ke zameen mein fasad kyun phailate hain? Yeh is ka jawab hai ke jo kuch ho raha hai woh hukm-e-Rab se aur ijazat-e-Allah se dushmanan-e-Allah ko zaleel o nakaam karne aur unhe past o badnaseeb karne ke liye ho raha hai jo darakht baqi rakhe jayen woh ijazat se aur jo kaate jaate hain woh bhi maslihat ke sath, yeh bhi marwi hai ke ba'az muhajireen ne ba'az ko un darakhton ke kaatne se mana kiya tha ke aakhir-kar to yeh musalmanon ko ba-taur maal-e-ghanimat milne wale hain phir unhe kyun kaata jaye? Jis par yeh aayat utri ke rokne wale bhi haq ba-janib hain aur kaatne wale bhi bar-haq hain un ki niyat musalmanon ke nafe ki hai aur un ki niyat kafiron ko ghaiz o ghazab mein lane aur unhe un ki shararat ka maza chakhane ki hai, aur yeh bhi irada hai ke is se jal kar woh ghusse mein phir kar maidan mein ayen toh phir do do haath hojayen aur aada-e-Deen ko kifar-e-kirdar tak pohncha diya jaye, sahaba ne yeh fa'il kar toh liya phir dare ke aisa na ho kaatne mein ya baqi chhorne mein Allah ki taraf se koi muakhza ho toh unhon ne Huzoor ﷺ se poocha aur yeh aayat nazil hui. Yaani dono baaton par ajr hai kaatne par bhi aur chhorne par bhi, ba'az riwayaton mein hai katwaye bhi thay aur jalwaye bhi thay. Banu Quraiza ke yahudiyon par is waqt Huzoor ﷺ ne ehsan kiya aur unko Madina Sharif mein hi rehne diya lekin bil-akhir jab yeh bhi muqabale par aaye aur munh ki khai toh unke larne wale mard toh qatal kiye gaye aur auratein, bachche aur maal musalmanon mein taqseem kar diye gaye haan jo log Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hogaye aur iman laye woh bach rahe, phir Madina se tamam yahudiyon ko nikaal diya Banu Qainqa' ko bhi jin mein se Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam R.A thay aur Banu Haritha ko bhi aur kul yahudiyon ko jala-watan kiya. In tamam waqeat ko arab shairon ne apne ash'ar mein bhi nihayat khoobi se ada kiya hai, jo Seerat Ibn Ishaq mein marwi hai yeh waqia baqoul Ibn Ishaq ke Uhad aur Bir Ma'unah ke baad ka hai aur baqoul Urwah Badr ke chheh mahine baad ka hai wallahu a'lam.

Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke asmanon aur zameen ki har ek cheez Allah Ta'ala ki tasbeeh, taqdees, tamjeed, takbeer, tauheed mein mashghool hai, jaise aur jagah farman hai: (Wa in min shai'in illa yusabbihu bihamdihi wa lakin la tafqohuna tasbeehahum, innahu kana haleeman ghafoora) (Al-Isra: 44). Yaani har cheez Allah Ta'ala ki pakeezgi aur sana khwani karti hai, woh ghalba wala aur buland janab wala aur aali sarkar wala hai aur apne tamam ahkaam-o-farman mein hikmat wala hai. 

Jis ne Ahl-e-Kitab ke kafiron yaani qabeela Bani Nazeer ke yahudiyon ko unke gharon se nikala, iska mukhtasar qissa yeh hai ke Madina mein aa kar Huzoor ﷺ ne in yahudiyon se sulh kar li thi ke na aap in se ladein na yeh aap se ladein, lekin in logon ne is ahd ko tod diya jin ki wajah se Allah ka ghazab un par nazil hua, Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi ﷺ ko un par ghalib kiya aur aap ne unhein yahan se nikal diya. 

Musalmanon ko kabhi iska khayal tak na tha, khud yeh yahud bhi samajh rahe the ke in mazboot qilon ke hote hue koi unka kuch nahi bigad sakta, lekin jab Allah ki pakad aayi yeh sab cheezein yunhi rakhi ki rakhi reh gayi aur achanak is tarah girift mein aa gaye ke hairan reh gaye aur aap ne unhein Madina se nikalwa diya. Baaz toh Sham ki zaraati zameenon mein chale gaye jo hashar-o-nashar ki jagah hai aur baaz Khaibar ki taraf ja nikle. Un se keh diya gaya tha ke apne unton par lad kar jo le ja sako apne sath le jao, isliye unhone apne gharon ko tod phod kar jo cheezein le ja sakte the apne sath utha lein, jo reh gayi woh Musalmanon ke hath lagin. 

Is waqya ko bayan kar ke farmata hai ke Allah ke aur uske Rasool ﷺ ke mukhalifin ka anjam dekho aur is se ibrat hasil karo ke kis tarah un par azab-e-ilahi achanak aapada aur duniya mein bhi tabaah-o-barbaad kiye gaye aur akhirat mein bhi zaleel-o-ruswa ho gaye aur dardnak azab mein ja pade.

Abu Dawood mein hai ke Ibn Ubayy aur uske mushrik sathiyon ko jo qabeela Aus-o-Khazraj mein se thay, kuffar-e-Quresh ne khat likha. Yeh khat unhein Huzoor ﷺ ke maidan-e-Badr se wapas lautne se pehle mil gaya tha. Is mein tehreer tha ke tum ne Huzoor ﷺ ko apne shehar mein thehraya hai, pas ya toh tum us se ladai karo aur use nikaal kar baahar karo ya hum tumhein nikaal dein ge aur apne tamam lashkaroun ko le kar tum par hamla karein ge aur tumhare tamam ladne walon ko hum teh-tegh kar dein ge aur tumhari aurton ladkiyon ko loundiyan bana lein ge. Allah ki qasam yeh ho kar hi rahega, ab tum soch samajh lo. 

Abdullah bin Ubayy aur uske but-parast sathiyon ne is khat ko pa kar aapas mein mashwara kiya aur khufiya taur par Huzoor ﷺ se ladai karne ki tajweez bil-ittifaq manzoor kar li. Jab Huzoor ﷺ ko yeh khabrein maaloom huin toh aap khud un ke pas gaye aur un se farmaya ke mujhe maaloom hua hai ke Quraishiyon ka khat kaam kar gaya aur tum log apni mout ke saaman apne haathon karne lage ho, tum apni aulaadon aur apne bhaiyon ko apne haathon zibah karna chahte ho, main tumhein phir ek martaba moqa deta hoon ke soch samajh lo aur apne is bad-iraday se baaz aao. 

Huzoor ﷺ ke is irshad ne un par asar kiya aur woh log apni apni jagah chale gaye lekin Quresh ne Badr se farigh ho kar unhein phir ek khat likha aur isi tarah dhamkaya. Unhein un ki quwat, un ki tadad aur un ke mazboot qilay yaad dilaye magar yeh phir akad mein aa gaye aur Banu Nazir ne saf taur par bad-ahdi par kamar bandh li aur Huzoor ﷺ ke pas qasid bheja ke aap tees aadmi le kar aaiye, hum mein se bhi tees zil-ilm aadmi aate hain, hamare tumhare darmiyan ki jagah par yeh saath aadmi milein aur aapas mein baat-cheet ho, agar yeh log aap ko sacha maan lein aur iman le aayein toh hum bhi aap ke sath hain.

Is bad-ahdi ki wajah se doosre din subh Rasool Allah ﷺ ne apna lashkar le ja kar un ka mohasra kar liya aur un se farmaya ke ab agar tum naye sire se amn-o-aman ka ahd-o-paiman karo to khair warna tumhein amn nahi, unhon ne saaf inkaar kar diya aur larne marne par tayyar ho gaye, chunacha din bhar larhai hoti rahi, doosri subh ko Aap Bani Quraiza ki taraf lashkar le kar barhe aur Bani Nazir ko yunhi chhora, un se bhi yahi farmaya ke tum naye sire se ahd-o-paiman karo, unhon ne manzoor kar liya aur moahda ho gaya, Aap wahan se farig ho kar phir Bani Nazir ke paas aaye, larhai shuru hui, akhir yeh hare aur Huzoor ﷺ ne unhein hukm diya ke tum Madina khali kar do, jo asbab le jana chaho aur oonton par lad kar le jao, chunacha unhon ne ghar baar ka asbab yahan tak ke darwaze aur lakdiyan bhi oonton par ladin aur jala-watan ho gaye, un ke khajooron ke darakht khas-tah Rasool Allah ﷺ ke ho gaye, Allah Ta'ala ne yeh Aap ko hi dilwa diye, jaise aayat (Wama afa'allahu 'ala rasulihi minhum fama awjaftum 'alaihi min khailin wa la rikaibin wa lakinnallaha yusallitu rusulahu 'ala man yasha'u, wallahu 'ala kulli shayin qadir) (Al-Hashr: 6) mein hai, lekin An-Hazrat ﷺ ne aksar hissa Muhajirin ko de diya, wahan Ansarion mein se sirf do hi hajatmandon ko hissa diya, baqi sab Muhajirin mein taqseem kar diya. Taqseem ke baad jo baqi reh gaya tha, yahi woh maal tha jo Rasool Allah ﷺ ka sadqa tha aur jo Bani Fatima ke haath laga. Ghazwa-e-Bani Nazir ka mukhtasar qissa aur sabab yeh hai ke mushrikon ne dhokha bazi se Sahaba-e-Karam ko Bi'r Ma'una mein shaheed kar diya, un ki tadad sattar thi, un mein se ek Hazrat 'Amr bin Umayyah Zamri ؓ bach kar bhaag nikle, Madina Sharif ki taraf aaye, aate aate moqa pa kar unhon ne Qabila Bani 'Amir ke do shakhson ko qatal kar diya, halanke yeh qabila Rasool Allah ﷺ se moahda kar chuka tha aur Aap ne unhein amn-o-aman de rakha tha, lekin is ki khabar Hazrat 'Amr ko na thi, jab yeh Madine pahuche aur Huzoor ﷺ se zikr kiya to Aap ne farmaya tum ne unhein qatal kar dala, ab mujhe un ke warison ko diyat yaani jurmana-e-qatal ada karna parega, Bani Nazir aur Bani 'Amir mein bhi half-o-aqd aur aapas mein masalihat thi, is liye Huzoor ﷺ un ki taraf chale taake kuch yeh dein, kuch Aap dein aur Bani 'Amir ko razi kar liya jaye. Qabila Bani Nazir ki garhi Madina ke mashriq ki janib kayi meel ke fasle par thi, jab Aap yahan pahuche to unhon ne kaha haan Huzoor ﷺ hum mein mojood hain, abhi abhi jama kar ke apne hisse ke mutabiq Aap ki khidmat mein hazir karte hain, idhar Aap se hat kar yeh log aapas mein mashwara karne lage ke is se behtar moqa kab haath lage ga.

Is waqt aap qabze mein hain aao kaam tamam kar dalo, chunacha yeh mashwara huwa ki jis deewar se aap lage baithe hain us ghar par koi chadh jaye aur wahan se bada sa patthar Aap ﷺ par phenk de ki Aap ﷺ dab jayein, Amr bin Mujash bin Kaab is kaam par muqarrar huwa us ne aap ki jaan lene ka beeda uthaya aur chhat par chadh gaya chahta tha ki patthar ludhka de itne mein Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Jibreel A.S ko Huzoor ﷺ ke paas bheja aur hukm diya ki aap yahan se uth khade hon chunacha aap foran hat gaye aur yeh bad-batin apne bure irade mein nakaam rahe. Aap ke sath us waqt chand sahaba the mislan Hazrat Abu Bakar Siddique R.A, Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A, Hazrat Ali R.A waghera aap yahan se foran Madina Sharif ki taraf chal pade, idhar jo sahaba aap ke sath na the aur Madina mein aap ke muntazir the unhein dair lagne ke baais khayal huwa aur woh aap ko dhoondne ke liye nikal khade hue lekin ek shakhs se maloom huwa ki aap Madina Sharif pahunch gaye hain chunacha yeh log wahin aaye poochha ki Huzoor ﷺ kya waqiya hai ? Aap ne sara qissa keh sunaya aur hukm diya ki jihad ki taiyari karo mujahideen ne kamrein baandh liin aur Allah ki rah mein nikal khade hue. Yahoodiyon ne lashkaron ko dekh kar apne qile ke phatak band kar diye aur panah-guzin ho gaye aap ne muhasra kar liya phir hukm diya ki unke khajoor ke darakht jo aas-paas hain woh kaat diye jayein aur jala diye jayein, ab to yahood cheekhne lage ki yeh kya ho raha hai ? Aap to zameen mein fasaad karne se auron ko rokte the aur fasadiyon ko bura kehte the phir yeh kya hone laga ? Pas idhar to darakht katne ka gham, idhar jo kumak aane wali thi us ki taraf se mayusi in dono cheezon ne in yahoodiyon ki kamar tod di.

Kumak ka waqiah yeh hai ke Banu Awf bin Khazraj ka qabila jis mein Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul aur Wadiah bin Malik, Ibn Abu Qauqal aur Suwaid aur Dais waghairah thay un logon ne Banu Nazir ko kahla bheja tha ke tum muqablay par jamey raho aur qila khali na karo hum tumhari madad par hain tumhara dushman hamara dushman hai hum tumhare sath mil kar is se larenge aur agar tum niklay toh hum bhi niklenge, lekin ab tak un ka yeh wada pura na hua aur unhon ne yahudiyon ki koi madad na ki, idhar un ke dil maroub hogaye toh unhon ne darkhwast ki ke ya Rasulallah (ﷺ) hamari jan-bakhshi kijiye hum Madina chor jatay hain lekin hum apna jo maal oonton par lad kar le jasakein woh humein de diya jaye Aap (ﷺ) ne un par raham kha kar un ki yeh darkhwast manzoor farma li aur yeh log yahan se chalay gaye jatay waqt apnay darwazon tak ko ukhaar kar le gaye gharon ko gira gaye aur Sham aur Khaibar mein ja kar abad hogaye, un ke baqi ke ahl-e-khaas Rasulallah (ﷺ) ke hogaye ke Aap jis tarah chahhein unhein kharch karein chunancha Aap (ﷺ) ne Muhajireen-e-Awwaleen ko yeh maal taqseem kardiya, haan Ansar mein se sirf do shakhson ko yani Sahl bin Hunaif aur Abu Dujana Simak bin Kharsha ko diya is liye ke yeh dono hazrat masakeen thay, Banu Nazir mein se sirf do shakhs musalman hue jin ke maal unhi ke paas rahay ek toh Yamin bin Umair jo Amr bin Hajjash ke chacha ke larkay ka larka tha yeh Amr woh hai jis ne Huzoor (ﷺ) par patthar phenknay ka bera uthaya tha, doosray Abu Saad bin Wahab aik martaba Huzoor (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Yamin se farmaya ke hey Yamin teray is chacha zad bhai ne dekh toh meray sath kis qadar bura bartao barta aur mujhay nuqsaan pohnchanay ki kis bebaki se koshish ki ? Hazrat Yamin ne aik shakhs ko kuch dena kar ke Amr ko qatl kara diya, Surah Hashr isi waqiah Banu Nazir ke baray mein utri hai, Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmatay hain jisay is mein shaq ho ke Mahshar ki zameen Sham ka mulk hai woh is ayat ko parh lay, in yahudiyon se jab Rasulallah (ﷺ) ne farmaya ke tum yahan se nikal jao toh unhon ne kaha hum kahan jayen ?

Aap ne farmaya mahshar ki zameen ki taraf, Hazrat Hasan farmate hain ke jab Huzoor ﷺ ne Bani Nazir ko jala watan kiya toh farmaya yeh awal hashar hai aur hum bhi uske peechhe hi peechhe hain (Ibn Jareer). Bani Nazir ke un qilon ka muhasra sirf chhe roz raha tha, muhasireen ko qile ki mazbooti, yahudiyon ki ziyadati, yakjehti, munafiqeen ki sazishen aur khufiya chaalen waghera dekh kar hargiza yeh yaqeen na tha ke is qadar jald yeh qila khaali kar denge. Idhar khud yahud bhi apne qile ki mazbooti par nazan the aur jaante the ke woh har tarah mehfooz hain, lekin Amr-e-Ilahi aisi jagah se aa gaya jo un ke khayal mein bhi na thi. Yahi dastoor Allah ka hai ke makkar apni makkari hi mein rehte hain aur be-khabar par azaab-e-ilahi aa jata hai. Un ke dilon mein raub chha gaya, bhala raub kyun na chhata, muhasra karne wale woh the jinhe Allah ki taraf se raub diya gaya tha ke dushman maheena bhar ki raah par ho aur wahin uska dil dehalne laga tha, Salawatullahi wa Salamuhu Alaih. 

Yahudi apne haathon apne gharon ko barbaad karne lage, chhaton ki lakdi aur darwaze le jaane ke liye todne phodne shuru kar diye. Muqatil farmate hain musalmanon ne bhi un ke ghar tode, is tarah ke jaise jaise aage badhte gaye, un ke jo jo makaanat waghera qabze mein aate gaye, maidan kushaada karne ke liye unhe dhate gaye. Isi tarah khud yahud bhi apne makaano ko aage se toh mehfooz karte jaate the aur peechhe se naqb laga kar nikalne ke raaste banate jaate the. Phir farmata hai, Ae aankhon walo! Ibrat hasil karo aur us Allah se daro jis ki laathi mein awaaz nahi. Agar un yahudiyon ke muqaddar mein jala watani na hoti toh unhe is se bhi sakht azaab diya jata, yeh qatal hote aur qaid kar liye jaate waghera waghera, phir aakhirat ke badtareen azaab bhi un ke liye taiyar hain. 

Bani Nazir ki yeh ladai Jang-e-Badr ke chhe mah baad hui, maal jo oonton par lad jayein unhe le jaane ki ijazat thi magar hathiyar le jaane ki ijazat na thi. Yeh us qabeele ke log the jinhe is se pehle kabhi jala watani hui hi na thi. Ba-qaul Hazrat Urwah bin Zubair shuru surat se fasiqeen tak aayatein isi waqie ke bayaan mein nazil hui hain. Jala ke maane qatal-o-fana ke bhi kiye gaye hain, Huzoor ﷺ ne unhe jala watani ke waqt teen teen mein ek ek oont aur ek ek mashk di thi. Is faisle ke baad bhi Huzoor ﷺ ne Muhammad bin Maslamah ؓ ko un ke paas bheja tha aur unhe ijazat di thi ke teen din mein apna saamaan theek kar ke chale aayein. Maal-e-Fay ki tareef, wazahat aur hukum-e-Rasool (ﷺ) ki ta'meel hi asal iman hai. Fay kis maal ko kehte hain? Uski sifat kya hai? Uska hukum kya hai? Yeh sab yahan bayan ho raha hai. 

Fay us maal ko kehte hain jo dushman se lare bhire baghair musalmano ke qabze mein aa jaye, jaise Banu Nazir ka yeh maal tha jiska zikr upar guzar chuka ke musalmano ne apne ghore ya oont us par nahi doraye the yaani un kuffaar se aamne samne koi muqabla aur larai nahi hui thi balki unke dil Allah ne apne Rasool (ﷺ) ki haibat se bhar diye aur woh apne qile khali kar ke qabze mein aa gaye, ise "Fay" kehte hain aur yeh maal Huzoor (ﷺ) ka ho gaya, aap jis tarah chahein is mein tasarruf karein, pas aap ne neki aur islah ke kamo mein ise kharch kiya jiska bayan iske baad wali aur dusri riwayat mein hai. 

Pas farmata hai ke Banu Nazir ka jo maal ba-taur Fay ke Allah Ta'ala ne apne Rasool ko dilwaya jis par musalmano ne apne ghore ya oont doraye na the balki sirf Allah ne apne fazal se apne Rasool (ﷺ) ko us par ghalba de diya tha aur Allah par yeh kya mushkil hai? Woh to har ek cheez par qudrat rakhta hai na us par kisi ka ghalba na use koi rokne wala balki sab par ghalib wahi, sab uske tab-e-farman. 

Phir farmaya ke jo shehar is tarah fateh kiye jayein unke maal ka yahi hukum hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ise apne qabze mein karenge phir unhe denge jiska bayan is aayat mein hai aur iske baad wali aayat mein hai, yeh hai Fay ke maal ka masraf aur uske kharch ka hukum.

Chanacha Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke Bani Nazir ke maal ba-taur-e-Fay ke khaas Rasulullah ﷺ ke ho gaye thay, Aap us mein se apne ghar walon ko saal bhar tak ka kharch dete thay aur jo bach rehta use alat-e-jang aur saman-e-harb mein kharch karte (Sunan o Musnad waghera). Abu Dawood mein Hazrat Malik bin Aus se marwi hai ke Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab ne mujhe din charhe bulaya, main ghar gaya toh dekha ke Aap ek chauki par jis par koi kapra waghera na tha baithe hue hain, mujhe dekh kar farmaya tumhari kaum ke chand log aaye hain, maine unhe kuch diya hai tum ise le kar un mein taqseem kar do. Maine kaha acha hota agar janab kisi aur ko yeh kaam sonpte, Aap ne farmaya nahi tum hi karo, maine kaha bahut behtar, itne mein Aap ka darogha Yarfa aaya aur kaha, A商品の Amir-ul-Momineen mera aur inka faisla kijiye yani Hazrat Ali ka. Toh pehle jo chaaron buzurg aaye thay un mein se bhi baaz ne kaha, haan Amir-ul-Momineen in dono ke darmiyan faisla kar dijiye aur unhe rahat pahunchaiye. Hazrat Malik farmate hain us waqt mere dil mein khayal aaya ke in chaaron buzurgon ko in dono hazraat ne hi apne se pehle yahan bheja hai. Hazrat Umar R.A ne farmaya tehro, phir un chaaron ki taraf mutawajja ho kar farmaya tumhein us Allah ki qasam jis ke hukum se asman o zameen qaim hain, kya tumhein maloom hai ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya hai hamara warisa banta nahi jata hum jo kuch chhor jayen woh sadqa hai? Phir farmaya Huzoor ﷺ ke faut hone ke baad Abu Bakr wali bane aur tum dono Khalifa-e-Rasool ﷺ ke paas aaye, اے Abbas tum to apni qarabat-dari jata kar apne chacha-zaad bhai ke maal mein se apna wirsa talab karte the aur yehi yani Hazrat Ali apna haq jata kar apni biwi yani Hazrat Fatima ki taraf se unke walid ke maal se wirsa talab karte the jiske jawab mein tum dono se Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique R.A ne farmaya ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ka farman hai, hamara wirsa baanta nahi jata hum jo chhor jayein woh sadqa hai. Allah khoob janta hai ke Hazrat Abu Bakr yaqinan rast-go, naik-kaar, rushd-o-hidayat wale aur tabe-e-haq the, chunache is maal ki wilayat Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique R.A ne ki, aap ke faut hojane ke baad aap ka aur Rasool Allah ﷺ ka khalifa main bana aur woh maal meri wilayat mein raha, phir aap dono ek salah se mere paas aaye aur mujhse ise manga, jiske jawab mein main ne kaha ke agar tum is shart se is maal ko apne qabze mein karo ke jis tarah Rasool Allah ﷺ ise kharch karte the tum bhi karte rahoge to main tumhe saunp deta hoon, tum ne is baat ko qubool kiya aur Allah ko beech mein de kar tum ne is maal ki wilayat li, phir tum jo ab aaye ho to kya is ke siwa koi aur faisla chahte ho? Qasam Allah ki qayamat tak is ke siwa is ka koi faisla main nahi kar sakta, haan yeh ho sakta hai ke agar tum apne wade ke mutabiq is maal ki nigrani aur is ka sarf nahi kar sakte to tum ise phir loota do taake main aap ise usi tarah kharch karoon jis tarah Rasool Allah ﷺ karte the aur jis tarah Khilafat-e-Siddiqi mein aur aaj tak hota raha.

Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke log Nabi ﷺ ko apne khajooron ke darakht waghera de diya karte the yahan tak ke Banu Quraiza aur Banu Nazir ke amwal Aap ke qabze mein aaye to ab Aap ne un logon ko un ko diye hue maal wapas dene shuru kiye, Hazrat Anas ko bhi un ke ghar walon ne Aap ki khidmat mein bheja ke hamara diya hua bhi sab ya jitna chahein hamein wapas kardein main ne ja kar Huzoor ﷺ ko yaad dilaya Aap ne woh sab wapas karne ko farmaya, lekin yeh sab Hazrat Umm-e-Aiman ko apni taraf se de chuke the unhein jab maloom huwa ke yeh sab mere qabze se nikal jaye ga to unhon ne aa kar meri gardan mein kapra daal diya aur mujh se farmane lagin Allah ki kasam jis ke siwa koi mabood nahi Hazrat ﷺ tujhe yeh nahi dein ge Aap to mujhe woh sab kuch de chuke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya Umm-e-Aiman tum na ghabrao hum tumhein us ke badle itna itna dein ge lekin woh na manin aur yehi kahe chali gayin, Aap ne farmaya acha aur itna itna hum tumhein dein ge lekin woh ab bhi khush na huin aur wahi farmati rahein, Aap ne farmaya lo hum tumhein itna itna aur dein ge yahan tak ke jitna unhein de rakha tha us se jab taqreeban das guna zyada dene ka wada Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya tab Aap razi ho kar khamosh ho gain aur hamara maal hamein mil gaya, yeh Fay ka maal jin panch jagahon mein sarf hoga yehi jaghein ghanimat ke maal ke sarf karne ki bhi hain aur Surah Anfal mein un ki poori tashreeh-o-tauzeeh ke sath kamil tafsir Alhamdulillah guzar chuki hai is liye hum yahan bayan nahi karte. Phir farmata hai ke maal-e-Fay ke yeh masarif hum ne is liye wazahat ke sath bayan kar diye ke yeh maal-daron ke hath lag kar kahin un ka luqma ban ban jaye aur apni man-mani khwahishon ke mutabiq woh ise udayein aur maskeenon ke hath na lage. Phir farmata hai ke jis kaam ke karne ko mere Paighambar ﷺ tum se kahein tum ise karo aur jis kaam se woh tumhein rokein tum us se ruk jao. Yaqeen mano ke jis ka woh hukm karte hain woh bhalai ka kaam hota hai aur jis se woh rokte hain woh burai ka kaam hota hai. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke ek aurat Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A ke paas aayi aur kaha aap godne se (yaani chamre par ya haathon par auratein soyi waghera se gadwa kar jo taron ki tarah nishan waghera bana leti hain) us se aur baalon mein baal mila لینے se (jo auratein apne baalon ko lamba zahir karne ke liye karti hain) mana farmate hain to kya yeh mamanat Kitabullah mein hai ya Hadith-e-Rasul ﷺ mein? Aap ne farmaya Kitabullah mein bhi aur Hadith-e-Rasulullah ﷺ mein bhi dono mein is mamanat ko pata hoon us aurat ne kaha Allah ki kasam dono loohon ke darmiyan jis qadr Quran Sharif hai main ne sab parha hai aur khoob dekh bhal ki hai lekin main ne to kahin is mamanat ko nahi paya Aap ne farmaya kya tum ne aayat (Wama atakumur-rasulu fakhuzuha wama nahakum anhu fantahu) (Al-Hashr: 7) nahi parhi? Us ne kaha han yeh to parhi hai.

Farmaya (Quran se sabit hua ke hukm-e-Rasool (ﷺ) aur mamanat-e-Rasool (ﷺ) qabil-e-amal hain ab suno) khud main ne Rasoolullah (ﷺ) se suna hai ke Aap ne godne se aur baalon mein baal milane se aur peshani aur chehre ke baal nochne se mana farmaya hai (yeh bhi auratein apni khubsurti zahir karne ke liye karti hain aur is zamaney mein to mard bhi bakasrat karte hain) us aurat ne kaha Hazrat yeh to aap ki ghar waliyan bhi karti hain Aap ne farmaya jao dekho, woh gayin aur dekh kar ayin aur kehne lagin Hazrat maaf kijiye galti hui in baaton mein se koi baat aap ke gharane waliyon mein main ne nahi dekhi, Aap ne farmaya kya tum bhool gayin ke Allah ke naik bande (Hazrat Shuaib (A.S)) ne kya farmaya tha (Wa ma uridu an ukhalifakum ila ma anhakum anhu 88) 11. (Hud: 88) yaani main yeh nahi chahta ke tumhein jis cheez se rokun khud main us ka khilaf karun, Musnad Ahmad aur Bukhari o Muslim mein hai ke Hazrat Ibn Masood (R.A) ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala laanat bhejta hai us aurat par jo godwaye aur jo gode aur jo apni peshani ke baal le aur jo khubsurti ke liye apne samne ke daanton ki kushadagi kare aur Allah Ta'ala ki banayi hui paidaish ko badalna chahe, yeh sun kar Banu Asad ki ek aurat jin ka naam Umm-e-Yaqoub tha aap ke paas ayin aur pucha ke kya aap ne is tarah farmaya hai? Aap ne jawab diya ke haan main is par laanat kyun na karun jis par Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne laanat ki hai? Aur jo Quran mein mojood hai, us ne kaha main ne pura Quran jitna bhi dono patton ke darmiyan hai awal se aakhir tak padha hai lekin main ne to yeh hukm kahin nahi paya, Aap ne farmaya agar tum soch samajh kar padhtin toh zaroor patin kya tum ne aayat (Wa ma atakumur Rasulu fakhuzuhu wa ma nahakum anhu fantahu) 59. (Al-Hashr: 7) nahi padhi? Us ne kaha haan yeh to padhi hai phir Aap ne woh hadith sunayi, us ne aap ke ghar walon ki nisbat kaha phir dekh kar ayin aur uzr-khwahisi ki us waqt Aap ne farmaya agar meri ghar wali aisa karti toh main us se milna chhod deta, Bukhari o Muslim mein Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ne farmaya jab main tumhein koi hukm dun toh jahan tak tum se ho sake use baja lao aur jab main tumhein kisi cheez se rokun toh ruk jao, Nasai mein Hazrat Umar (R.A) aur Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ne kadu ke bartan mein, sabz thaliya mein, khajoor ki lakdi ke kride hue bartan mein aur raal ki rangi hui thaliya mein nabeez banane se yaani khajoor ya kishmish waghera ke bhigo kar rakhne se mana farmaya hai phir usi aayat ki tilawat ki (Yaad rahe ke yeh hukm ab baqi nahi hai. (Mutarjim) phir farmata hai Allah ke azaab se bachne ke liye us ke ahkaam ki mamnu'at se bachte raho, yaad rakho ke us ki nafarmani mukhalifat inkar karne walon ko aur us ke mana kiye hue kaamon ke karne walon ko woh sakht saza aur dardnak azaab deta hai.)

Maal-e-Fay ki tareef, wazahat aur hukum-e-Rasool (ﷺ) ki ta'meel hi asal iman hai. Fay kis maal ko kehte hain? Uski sifat kya hai? Uska hukum kya hai? Yeh sab yahan bayan ho raha hai.
