Us ne kaha haan yeh to padhi hai phir Aap ne woh hadith sunayi, us ne aap ke ghar walon ki nisbat kaha phir dekh kar ayin aur uzr-khwahisi ki us waqt Aap ne farmaya agar meri ghar wali aisa karti toh main us se milna chhod deta, Bukhari o Muslim mein Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ne farmaya jab main tumhein koi hukm dun toh jahan tak tum se ho sake use baja lao aur jab main tumhein kisi cheez se rokun toh ruk jao, Nasai mein Hazrat Umar (R.A) aur Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ne kadu ke bartan mein, sabz thaliya mein, khajoor ki lakdi ke kride hue bartan mein aur raal ki rangi hui thaliya mein nabeez banane se yaani khajoor ya kishmish waghera ke bhigo kar rakhne se mana farmaya hai phir usi aayat ki tilawat ki (Yaad rahe ke yeh hukm ab baqi nahi hai. (Mutarjim) phir farmata hai Allah ke azaab se bachne ke liye us ke ahkaam ki mamnu'at se bachte raho, yaad rakho ke us ki nafarmani mukhalifat inkar karne walon ko aur us ke mana kiye hue kaamon ke karne walon ko woh sakht saza aur dardnak azaab deta hai.)

Mal-e-Fay ke haqdar: Upar bayan hua tha ke fay ka maal yani kafiron ka jo maal musalmano ke qabze mein maidan-e-jang mein lade bhade bagair agaya ho, uske malik Rasoolullah ﷺ hain. Phir aap yeh maal kise denge? Uska bayan ho raha hai ke iske haqdar woh gareeb muhajir hain jinhon ne Allah ko razi karne ke liye apni kaum ko naraz karliya, yahan tak ke unhein apna watan-e-aziz aur apne hath ka mushkilon se jama kiya hua maal waghera sab chhod chhad kar chal dena pada. Allah ke deen aur uske Rasool ﷺ ki madad mein barabar mashghool hain, Allah ke fazl-o-khushnudi ke mutalashi hain, yehi sachche log hain jinhon ne apna fe'l apne kaul ke mutabiq kar dikhaya, yeh ausaf sadat-e-muhajirin mein the ؓ. 

Phir Ansar ki madh bayan ho rahi hai aur unki fazilat, sharafat, karam aur buzurgi ka izhar ho raha hai, unki kushaada-deli, naik-nafsi, isar aur sakhawat ka zikr ho raha hai ke unhon ne muhajirin se pehle hi Dar-ul-Hijrat Madina mein apni bood-o-bash rakhi aur iman par qiyam rakha, muhajirin ke pahunchne se pehle hi yeh iman la chuke the balke bahut se muhajirin se bhi pehle yeh iman-dar ban gaye the. 

Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein is ayat ki tafsir ke mauqe par yeh riwayat hai ke Hazrat Umar ؓ ne farmaya: "Main apne baad ke khalifa kowasiyat karta hoon ke muhajirin-e-awaleen ke haq ada karta rahe, unki khatir-madarat mein kami na kare aur meri wasiyat hai ke Ansar ke sath bhi neki aur bhalai kare jinhon ne Madina mein jagah banai aur iman mein jagah hasil ki, unke bhale logon ki bhalaiyan qubul kare aur unki khataon se darguzar aur chashm-poshi karle." 

Unki sharafat-e-tab'i mulahiza ho ke jo bhi rah-e-Allah mein hijrat kar ke aaye yeh apne dil mein use ghar dete hain aur apna jaan-o-maal un par se nisar karna apna fakhr jante hain. 

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke muhajirin ne ek martaba kaha: "Ya Rasoolullah! Hum ne to duniya mein in Ansar jaise log nahi dekhe, thode mein se thoda aur bahut mein se bahut barabar hamein de rahe hain, muddaton se hamara kul kharch utha rahe hain balke naaz-bardariyan kar rahe hain aur kabhi chehre par shakan bhi nahi balke khidmat karte hain aur khush hote hain, dete hain aur ehsan nahi rakhte, kaam-kaaj khud karein aur kamai hamein dein." 

Huzoor ﷺ! Hamein to dar hai ke kahin hamare aamal ka sara ka sara ajr inhi ko na mil jaye. Aap ne farmaya: "Nahi nahi, jab tak tum inki sana aur tareef karte rahoge aur inke liye duayein mangte rahoge."

Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ki An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Ansariyon ko bula kar farmaya ki main Bahrain ka ilaqa tumhare naam likh deta hoon, unhon ne kaha Ya Rasulallah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab tak aap hamare Muhajir bhaiyon ko bhi utna hi na dein hum ise na lenge, aap ne farmaya achha agar nahi lete toh dekho آئندہ bhi sabr karte rehna mere baad aisa waqt bhi aayega ki auron ko diya jayega aur tumhe chhod diya jayega. Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki aur hadith mein hai ki Ansariyon ne kaha ki Ya Rasulallah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamare khajoor ke baaghat hum mein aur hamare Muhajir bhaiyon mein taqseem kar dijiye, aap ne farmaya nahi, phir farmaya suno kaam-kaaj bhi tum hi karo aur hum sab ko toh paidawar mein shareek rakho, Ansar ne jawab diya Ya Rasulallah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) humein yeh bhi bakhushi manzoor hai.

Phir farmata hai yeh apne dilon mein koi hasad un Muhajirin ki qadr-o-manzilat aur zikr-o-martabat par nahi karte, jo unhein mil jaye unhein us par rashq nahi hota, usi matlab par is hadith ki dalalat bhi hai jo Musnad Ahmad mein Hazrat Anas R.A ki riwayat se marwi hai ke hum log Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas baithe hue the ke Aap ne farmaya abhi ek jannati shakhs aane wala hai, thodi der mein ek Ansari R.A apne bayen haath mein apni jootiyan liye hue taza wuzu kar ke aa rahe the dadhi par se pani tapak raha tha dusre din bhi usi tarah hum baithe hue the ke Aap ne yehi farmaya aur wohi shakhs usi tarah aaye teesre din bhi yehi hua Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin Aas aaj dekhte bhalte rahe aur jab majlis-e-Nabwi khatam hui aur yeh buzurg wahan se uth kar chale toh yeh bhi unke peeche ho liye aur Ansari se kehne lage Hazrat mujh mein aur mere walid mein kuch bol chaal ho gayi hai jis par main qasam kha baitha hoon ke teen din tak apne ghar nahi jaunga pas agar aap meharbani farma kar mujhe ijazat dein toh main yeh teen din aap ke haan guzaar dun unhon ne kaha bahut achha chunacha Hazrat Abdullah R.A ne yeh teen raten unke ghar unke sath guzari dekha ke woh raat ko tahajjud ki lambi namaz bhi nahi padhte sirf itna karte hain ke jab aankh khule Allah Ta'ala ka zikr aur uski badai apne bistar par hi lete lete kar lete hain yahan tak ke subah ki namaz ke liye uthein haan yeh zaruri baat thi ke main ne unke munh se siwaye kalma-e-khair ke aur kuch nahi suna, jab teen raten guzar gain toh mujhe unka amal bahut hi halka sa maloom hone laga ab main ne unke kaha ke Hazrat darasal na toh mere aur mere walid sahab ke darmiyan koi aisi baten hui thin na main ne narazgi ke baais ghar chhoda tha balki waqia yeh hua ke teen martaba An-Hazrat ﷺ ne farmaya ke abhi ek jannati shakhs aa raha hai aur teenon martaba aap hi aaye toh main ne irada kiya ke aap ki khidmat mein kuch din reh kar dekhun toh sahi ke aap aisi kaunsi ibadatein karte hain jo jeete ji ba-zaban-e-Rasul ﷺ aap ke jannati hone ki yaqeeni khabar hum tak pahunch gayi chunacha main ne yeh bahana kiya aur teen raat tak aap ki khidmat mein raha taake aap ke aamal dekh kar main bhi waise hi amal shuru kar dun lekin main ne toh aap ko na toh koi naya aur ahem amal karte hue dekha na ibadat mein hi auron se zyada badha hua dekha ab ja raha hoon lekin zabani ek sawal hai ke aap hi batayiye aakhir woh kaunsa amal hai jisne aap ko Rasulullah ﷺ ki zabani jannati banaya?

Aap ne farmaya bas tum mere aamal to dekh chuke un ke siva aur koi khas poshida amal to hai nahi chunacha main un se rukhsat ho kar chala thodi hi door nikla tha jo unhon ne mujhe aawaz di aur farmaya haan mera ek amal sunte jao woh yeh ke mere dil mein kabhi kisi musalman se dhokha bazi, hasad aur bughz ka irada bhi nahi hua main kabhi kisi musalman ka badkhwah nahi bana, Hazrat Abdullah ne yeh sun kar farmaya ke bas ab maloom ho gaya isi amal ne aap ko is darja tak pahunchaya hai aur yahi woh cheez hai jo har ek ke bas ki nahi. Imam Nasai bhi apni kitab ‘Amal Al-Yaum Wal-Lailah mein is hadis ko laye hain, gharz yeh hai ke un Ansar mein yeh wasaf tha ke Muhajirin ko agar koi maal waghera diya jaye aur unhein na mile toh yeh bura nahi mante the, Bani Nazir ke maal jab Muhajirin hi mein taqseem hue toh kisi Ansari ne is mein kalam kiya jis par ayat (Mā afā’allāhu ‘alā rasūlihī min ahli-l-qurā falillāhi wal-rrasūli wa li-dhī-l-qurbā wal-yatāmā wal-masākīni wa ibni-l-sabīl) [59. Al-Hashr: 7] utri, Aan Hazrat ﷺ ne farmaya tumhare Muhajir bhai maal aur aulaad chhod kar tumhari taraf aate hain Ansar ne kaha phir Huzoor ﷺ hamara maal un mein aur hum mein barabar baant dijiye Aap ne farmaya is se bhi zyada Isaar kar sakte ho? Unhon ne kaha jo Huzoor ﷺ ka irshad ho Aap ne farmaya Muhajir khet aur baghaat ka kaam nahi jante tum aap apne maal ko qabza mein rakho khud kaam karo khud baghaat mein mehnat karo aur paidawar mein unhein shareeq kar do Ansar ne ise bhi ba-kushada peshani manzoor kar liya. Phir farmata hai ke khud ko haajat hone ke bawajood bhi apne doosre bhaiyon ki haajat ko muqaddam rakhte hain apni zaroorat khwah baqi reh jaye lekin doosre musalman ki zaroorat jald poori ho jaye yeh un ki har waqt ki khwahish hai, ek sahih hadis mein bhi hai ke jis ke paas kami aur qillat ho khud ko zaroorat ho aur phir bhi sad

Lekin aik kehta hai is doosre ko pilaao doosra kehta hai is teesre ko pehle pilaao woh abhi teesre tak pohancha bhi nahi ke aik shaheed hojata hai, doosre ko dekhta hai ke woh bhi pyaasa hi chal basa, teesre ke paas aata hai lekin dekhta hai ke woh bhi sookhe honton hi Allah se ja mila. Allah Ta'ala in buzurgon se khush ho aur unhein bhi apni zaat se khush rakhe. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke aik shakhs Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaya aur kaha Ya Rasulullah ﷺ main sakht haajat mand hoon mujhe kuch khilwaiye Aap ne apne gharon mein aadmi bheja lekin tamam gharon se jawab mila ke Huzoor ﷺ hamare paas khud kuch nahi yeh maloom kar ke phir Aap ne aur logon se kaha ke koi hai jo aaj ki raat unhein apna mehmaan rakhe? Aik Ansari uth khare hue aur kaha Huzoor ﷺ main unhein apna mehmaan rakhunga chunacha yeh le gaye aur apni biwi se kaha dekho yeh Rasulullah ﷺ ke mehmaan hain aaj go hamein kuch bhi khane ko na mile lekin yeh bhooke na rahein biwi sahiba ne kaha aaj ghar mein bhi barkat hai bachchon ke liye albata kuch tukre rakhe hue hain Ansari ne farmaya achcha bachchon ko to bhala phusla kar bhooka sula do aur hum tum dono apne pet par kapda baandh kar faaqe se raat guzaar denge, khate waqt chiragh bujha dena taake mehmaan yeh samjhe ke hum kha rahe hain aur darasal hum khayenge nahi. Chunacha aisa hi kiya subah jab yeh shakhs Ansari Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaye to Aap ne farmaya ke is shakhs ke aur is ki biwi ke raat ke amal se Allah Ta'ala khush hua aur hans diya inhi ke bare mein (Wa yu'thiroona 'ala anfusihim wa lau kana bihim khasasah) (Al-Hashr: 9) nazil hui, Sahih Muslim ki riwayat mein in Ansari ka naam hai Hazrat Abu Talha R.A. Phir farmata hai jo apne nafs ki bakhili hirs aur laalach se bach gaya us ne nijat pa li. Musnad Ahmad aur Muslim mein hai Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain logon zulm se bacho! Qayamat ke din yeh zulm andhera ban jayega logon bakhili aur hirs se bacho yahi woh cheez hai jis ne tum se pehle logon ko barbad kar diya isi ki wajah se unhein ne khoonriziyan keen aur haram ko halal bana liya aur sanad se yeh bhi marwi hai ke fahsh se bacho. Allah Ta'ala fahsh baaton aur behayai ke kaamon ko naپسند farmata hai, hirs aur bakhili ki mazammat mein yeh alfaaz bhi hain ke isi ke baais aglon ne zulm kiye fisq-o-fujoor kiye aur qat-e-rahmi ki. Abu Dawood waghera mein hai Allah ki rah ka ghubar aur jahannam ka dhuaan kisi bande ke pet mein jama ho hi nahi sakta isi tarah bakhili aur iman bhi kisi bande ke dil mein jama nahi ho sakte, yani rah-e-Allah ki gard jis par padi woh jahannam se azaad ho gaya aur jis ke dil mein bakhili ne ghar kar liya us ke dil mein iman ke rehne ki gunjaish hi nahi rehti, Hazrat Abdullah R.A ke paas aa kar aik shakhs ne kaha اے Abu Abdul Rahman main to halak ho gaya Aap ne farmaya kya baat hai?

Kaha Quran mein toh hai jo apne nafs ki bukhli se bacha diya gaya usne falah pali aur main toh maal ko bara rokne wala hoon, kharch karte hue dil rukta hai Aap ne farmaya is kunjusi ka zikr is aayat mein nahi yahan murad bukhli se yeh hai ke tu apne kisi musalman bhai ka maal zulm se kha jaye, haan bukhli ba-ma'ani kunjusi bhi hai bohat buri cheez hai (Ibn Abi Hatim). 

Hazrat Abu Lahiyaaj Asadi Rahimahullah Ta'ala Alaih farmate hain ke Baitullah ka tawaf karte hue maine dekha ke ek sahab sirf yahi dua parh rahe hain: (Dua: Allahumma qini shuhha nafsi) Ilahi mujhe mere nafs ki hirs o araz se bacha le aakhir mujhse na raha gaya maine kaha aap sirf yahi dua kyun maang rahe hain? Usne kaha jab is se bachao ho gaya toh phir na zina-kari ho sakegi na chori aur na koi bura kaam, ab jo maine dekha toh woh Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Awf the ؓ (Ibn Jarir). 

Ek hadith mein hai jis ne zakat ada ki aur mehmandari ki aur Allah ki rah ke zaroori kaamo mein diya woh apne nafs ki bukhli se door ho gaya, phir maal-e-fai ke mustahiq logo ki teesri qism ka bayan ho raha hai ke Ansar aur Muhajir ke fuqra ke baad unke tabe jo unke baad ke log hain un mein se masakeen bhi is maal ke mustahiq hain jo Allah Ta'ala se apne se agle ba-iman logo ke liye maghfirat ki duaein karte rehte hain jaise ke Surah Baraat mein hai: 

(وَالسّٰبِقُوْنَ الْاَوَّلُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُهٰجِرِيْنَ وَالْاَنْصَارِ وَالَّذِيْنَ اتَّبَعُوْھُمْ بِاِحْسَانٍ ۙ رَّضِيَ اللّٰهُ عَنْھُمْ وَرَضُوْا عَنْهُ وَاَعَدَّ لَھُمْ جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِيْ تَحْتَهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَآ اَبَدًا ۭذٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيْمُ) (At-Tawbah: 100) 

Yaani awwal awwal sabqat karne wale Muhajir-o-Ansar aur unke baad ke woh log jo ehsaan mein unke mutabae hain Allah Ta'ala un sab se khush hai aur yeh sab Allah Ta'ala se raazi hain yani yeh baad ke log un aglo ke asaar-e-hasana aur awsaf-e-jameela ki ittiba karne wale aur unhe naik duaon se yaad rakhne wale hain goya zahir batin un ke tabe hain, is dua se Hazrat Imam Malik ؒ ne kitna pakeeza istadlal kiya hai ke Rafzi ko maal-e-fai se imam-e-waqt kuch na de kyunke woh Ashab-e-Rasool ﷺ ke liye dua karne ki bajaye unhe galiyan dete hain. 

Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa ؓ farmate hain ke in logo ko dekho kis tarah Quran ke khilaf karte hain Quran hukum deta hai ke Muhajir-o-Ansar ke liye duaein karo aur yeh galiyan dete hain phir yahi aayat Aap ne tilawat farmayi (Ibn Abi Hatim). 

Aur riwayat mein itna aur bhi hai ke maine tumhare Nabi ﷺ se suna hai ke yeh ummat khatam na hogi yahan tak ke unke pichle unke pehlo ko laanat karenge (Baghawi). 

Abu Dawood mein hai ke Hazrat Umar ne farmaya: 

(وَمَآ اَفَاۗءَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰي رَسُوْلِهٖ مِنْهُمْ فَمَآ اَوْجَفْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ خَيْلٍ وَّلَا رِكَابٍ وَّلٰكِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُسَلِّــطُ رُسُلَهٗ عَلٰي مَنْ يَّشَاۗءُ ۭ وَاللّٰهُ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ) (59)

(Al-Hashr: 6) mein jis maal-e-fai ka bayan hai woh toh khas Rasulullah ﷺ ka hai isi tarah uske baad ki (Ma afaa-allahu 'ala rasulihi min ahlil-qura falillahi wal-rasuli wa li-zil-qurba wal-yatama wal-masakini wabni-s-sabil. 59. (Al-Hashr: 7) wali ne aam kardiya hai tamam musalmanon ko is mein shamil kardiya hai ab ek musalman bhi aisa nahi jiska haq is maal mein na ho siwaye tumhare ghulamon ke, is hadith ki sanad mein intiqaa hai, Ibn Jarir mein hai Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A ne (Innama-s-sadaqatu lil-fuqara'i wal-masakini wal-'amilina 'alaiha wal-mu'allafati qulubuhum wa fi-r-riqabi wal-gharimina wa fi sabillahi wa ibni-s-sabilan fariqatan minallahu wallahu 'alimun hakim. 60. (At-Tawbah: 60) tak padh kar farmaya maal-e-zakat ke mustahiq toh yeh log hain phir (Wa'lamu annama ghanimtum min shai'in fa-anna lillahi khumusahu wal-rasuli wa li-zil-qurba wal-yatama wal-masakini wabni-s-sabil. 41. (Al-Anfal: 41) wali puri ayat ko padh kar farmaya maal-e-ghanimat ke mustahiq yeh log hain phir yeh (Ma afaa-allahu 'ala rasulihi min ahlil-qura falillahi wal-rasuli wa li-zil-qurba wal-yatama wal-masakini wabni-s-sabili kai la yakuna dulatam bainal-aghniya'i minkum wa ma atakumu-r-rasulu fakhudhuhu wa ma nahakum 'anhu fantahu wattaqullaha innal-laha shadidul-'iqab. 59. (Al-Hashr: 7) padh kar farmaya maal-e-fai ke mustahiqeen ko bayan farmate hue is ayat ne tamam musalmanon ko is maal-e-fai ka mustahiq kardiya hai, sab is ke mustahiq hain. Agar main zinda raha toh tum dekhoge ke gaon gothon ke charwaha ko bhi is ka hissa dunga jis ki peshani par is maal ke hasil karne ke liye pasina tak na aaya.))))

Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki aur hadith mein hai ki Ansariyon ne kaha ki Ya Rasulallah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamare khajoor ke baaghat hum mein aur hamare Muhajir bhaiyon mein taqseem kar dijiye, aap ne farmaya nahi, phir farmaya suno kaam-kaaj bhi tum hi karo aur hum sab ko toh paidawar mein shareek rakho, Ansar ne jawab diya Ya Rasulallah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) humein yeh bhi bakhushi manzoor hai.

Phir farmata hai yeh apne dilon mein koi hasad un Muhajirin ki qadr-o-manzilat aur zikr-o-martabat par nahi karte, jo unhein mil jaye unhein us par rashq nahi hota, usi matlab par is hadith ki dalalat bhi hai jo Musnad Ahmad mein Hazrat Anas R.A ki riwayat se marwi hai ke hum log Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas baithe hue the ke Aap ne farmaya abhi ek jannati shakhs aane wala hai, thodi der mein ek Ansari R.A apne bayen haath mein apni jootiyan liye hue taza wuzu kar ke aa rahe the dadhi par se pani tapak raha tha dusre din bhi usi tarah hum baithe hue the ke Aap ne yehi farmaya aur wohi shakhs usi tarah aaye teesre din bhi yehi hua Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin Aas aaj dekhte bhalte rahe aur jab majlis-e-Nabwi khatam hui aur yeh buzurg wahan se uth kar chale toh yeh bhi unke peeche ho liye aur Ansari se kehne lage Hazrat mujh mein aur mere walid mein kuch bol chaal ho gayi hai jis par main qasam kha baitha hoon ke teen din tak apne ghar nahi jaunga pas agar aap meharbani farma kar mujhe ijazat dein toh main yeh teen din aap ke haan guzaar dun unhon ne kaha bahut achha chunacha Hazrat Abdullah R.A ne yeh teen raten unke ghar unke sath guzari dekha ke woh raat ko tahajjud ki lambi namaz bhi nahi padhte sirf itna karte hain ke jab aankh khule Allah Ta'ala ka zikr aur uski badai apne bistar par hi lete lete kar lete hain yahan tak ke subah ki namaz ke liye uthein haan yeh zaruri baat thi ke main ne unke munh se siwaye kalma-e-khair ke aur kuch nahi suna, jab teen raten guzar gain toh mujhe unka amal bahut hi halka sa maloom hone laga ab main ne unke kaha ke Hazrat darasal na toh mere aur mere walid sahab ke darmiyan koi aisi baten hui thin na main ne narazgi ke baais ghar chhoda tha balki waqia yeh hua ke teen martaba An-Hazrat ﷺ ne farmaya ke abhi ek jannati shakhs aa raha hai aur teenon martaba aap hi aaye toh main ne irada kiya ke aap ki khidmat mein kuch din reh kar dekhun toh sahi ke aap aisi kaunsi ibadatein karte hain jo jeete ji ba-zaban-e-Rasul ﷺ aap ke jannati hone ki yaqeeni khabar hum tak pahunch gayi chunacha main ne yeh bahana kiya aur teen raat tak aap ki khidmat mein raha taake aap ke aamal dekh kar main bhi waise hi amal shuru kar dun lekin main ne toh aap ko na toh koi naya aur ahem amal karte hue dekha na ibadat mein hi auron se zyada badha hua dekha ab ja raha hoon lekin zabani ek sawal hai ke aap hi batayiye aakhir woh kaunsa amal hai jisne aap ko Rasulullah ﷺ ki zabani jannati banaya?

Aap ne farmaya bas tum mere aamal to dekh chuke un ke siva aur koi khas poshida amal to hai nahi chunacha main un se rukhsat ho kar chala thodi hi door nikla tha jo unhon ne mujhe aawaz di aur farmaya haan mera ek amal sunte jao woh yeh ke mere dil mein kabhi kisi musalman se dhokha bazi, hasad aur bughz ka irada bhi nahi hua main kabhi kisi musalman ka badkhwah nahi bana, Hazrat Abdullah ne yeh sun kar farmaya ke bas ab maloom ho gaya isi amal ne aap ko is darja tak pahunchaya hai aur yahi woh cheez hai jo har ek ke bas ki nahi. Imam Nasai bhi apni kitab ‘Amal Al-Yaum Wal-Lailah mein is hadis ko laye hain, gharz yeh hai ke un Ansar mein yeh wasaf tha ke Muhajirin ko agar koi maal waghera diya jaye aur unhein na mile toh yeh bura nahi mante the, Bani Nazir ke maal jab Muhajirin hi mein taqseem hue toh kisi Ansari ne is mein kalam kiya jis par ayat (Mā afā’allāhu ‘alā rasūlihī min ahli-l-qurā falillāhi wal-rrasūli wa li-dhī-l-qurbā wal-yatāmā wal-masākīni wa ibni-l-sabīl) [59. Al-Hashr: 7] utri, Aan Hazrat ﷺ ne farmaya tumhare Muhajir bhai maal aur aulaad chhod kar tumhari taraf aate hain Ansar ne kaha phir Huzoor ﷺ hamara maal un mein aur hum mein barabar baant dijiye Aap ne farmaya is se bhi zyada Isaar kar sakte ho? Unhon ne kaha jo Huzoor ﷺ ka irshad ho Aap ne farmaya Muhajir khet aur baghaat ka kaam nahi jante tum aap apne maal ko qabza mein rakho khud kaam karo khud baghaat mein mehnat karo aur paidawar mein unhein shareeq kar do Ansar ne ise bhi ba-kushada peshani manzoor kar liya. Phir farmata hai ke khud ko haajat hone ke bawajood bhi apne doosre bhaiyon ki haajat ko muqaddam rakhte hain apni zaroorat khwah baqi reh jaye lekin doosre musalman ki zaroorat jald poori ho jaye yeh un ki har waqt ki khwahish hai, ek sahih hadis mein bhi hai ke jis ke paas kami aur qillat ho khud ko zaroorat ho aur phir bhi sad

Lekin aik kehta hai is doosre ko pilaao doosra kehta hai is teesre ko pehle pilaao woh abhi teesre tak pohancha bhi nahi ke aik shaheed hojata hai, doosre ko dekhta hai ke woh bhi pyaasa hi chal basa, teesre ke paas aata hai lekin dekhta hai ke woh bhi sookhe honton hi Allah se ja mila. Allah Ta'ala in buzurgon se khush ho aur unhein bhi apni zaat se khush rakhe. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke aik shakhs Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaya aur kaha Ya Rasulullah ﷺ main sakht haajat mand hoon mujhe kuch khilwaiye Aap ne apne gharon mein aadmi bheja lekin tamam gharon se jawab mila ke Huzoor ﷺ hamare paas khud kuch nahi yeh maloom kar ke phir Aap ne aur logon se kaha ke koi hai jo aaj ki raat unhein apna mehmaan rakhe? Aik Ansari uth khare hue aur kaha Huzoor ﷺ main unhein apna mehmaan rakhunga chunacha yeh le gaye aur apni biwi se kaha dekho yeh Rasulullah ﷺ ke mehmaan hain aaj go hamein kuch bhi khane ko na mile lekin yeh bhooke na rahein biwi sahiba ne kaha aaj ghar mein bhi barkat hai bachchon ke liye albata kuch tukre rakhe hue hain Ansari ne farmaya achcha bachchon ko to bhala phusla kar bhooka sula do aur hum tum dono apne pet par kapda baandh kar faaqe se raat guzaar denge, khate waqt chiragh bujha dena taake mehmaan yeh samjhe ke hum kha rahe hain aur darasal hum khayenge nahi. Chunacha aisa hi kiya subah jab yeh shakhs Ansari Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaye to Aap ne farmaya ke is shakhs ke aur is ki biwi ke raat ke amal se Allah Ta'ala khush hua aur hans diya inhi ke bare mein (Wa yu'thiroona 'ala anfusihim wa lau kana bihim khasasah) (Al-Hashr: 9) nazil hui, Sahih Muslim ki riwayat mein in Ansari ka naam hai Hazrat Abu Talha R.A. Phir farmata hai jo apne nafs ki bakhili hirs aur laalach se bach gaya us ne nijat pa li. Musnad Ahmad aur Muslim mein hai Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain logon zulm se bacho! Qayamat ke din yeh zulm andhera ban jayega logon bakhili aur hirs se bacho yahi woh cheez hai jis ne tum se pehle logon ko barbad kar diya isi ki wajah se unhein ne khoonriziyan keen aur haram ko halal bana liya aur sanad se yeh bhi marwi hai ke fahsh se bacho. Allah Ta'ala fahsh baaton aur behayai ke kaamon ko naپسند farmata hai, hirs aur bakhili ki mazammat mein yeh alfaaz bhi hain ke isi ke baais aglon ne zulm kiye fisq-o-fujoor kiye aur qat-e-rahmi ki. Abu Dawood waghera mein hai Allah ki rah ka ghubar aur jahannam ka dhuaan kisi bande ke pet mein jama ho hi nahi sakta isi tarah bakhili aur iman bhi kisi bande ke dil mein jama nahi ho sakte, yani rah-e-Allah ki gard jis par padi woh jahannam se azaad ho gaya aur jis ke dil mein bakhili ne ghar kar liya us ke dil mein iman ke rehne ki gunjaish hi nahi rehti, Hazrat Abdullah R.A ke paas aa kar aik shakhs ne kaha اے Abu Abdul Rahman main to halak ho gaya Aap ne farmaya kya baat hai?

Kaha Quran mein toh hai jo apne nafs ki bukhli se bacha diya gaya usne falah pali aur main toh maal ko bara rokne wala hoon, kharch karte hue dil rukta hai Aap ne farmaya is kunjusi ka zikr is aayat mein nahi yahan murad bukhli se yeh hai ke tu apne kisi musalman bhai ka maal zulm se kha jaye, haan bukhli ba-ma'ani kunjusi bhi hai bohat buri cheez hai (Ibn Abi Hatim). 

Hazrat Abu Lahiyaaj Asadi Rahimahullah Ta'ala Alaih farmate hain ke Baitullah ka tawaf karte hue maine dekha ke ek sahab sirf yahi dua parh rahe hain: (Dua: Allahumma qini shuhha nafsi) Ilahi mujhe mere nafs ki hirs o araz se bacha le aakhir mujhse na raha gaya maine kaha aap sirf yahi dua kyun maang rahe hain? Usne kaha jab is se bachao ho gaya toh phir na zina-kari ho sakegi na chori aur na koi bura kaam, ab jo maine dekha toh woh Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Awf the ؓ (Ibn Jarir). 

Ek hadith mein hai jis ne zakat ada ki aur mehmandari ki aur Allah ki rah ke zaroori kaamo mein diya woh apne nafs ki bukhli se door ho gaya, phir maal-e-fai ke mustahiq logo ki teesri qism ka bayan ho raha hai ke Ansar aur Muhajir ke fuqra ke baad unke tabe jo unke baad ke log hain un mein se masakeen bhi is maal ke mustahiq hain jo Allah Ta'ala se apne se agle ba-iman logo ke liye maghfirat ki duaein karte rehte hain jaise ke Surah Baraat mein hai: 

(وَالسّٰبِقُوْنَ الْاَوَّلُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُهٰجِرِيْنَ وَالْاَنْصَارِ وَالَّذِيْنَ اتَّبَعُوْھُمْ بِاِحْسَانٍ ۙ رَّضِيَ اللّٰهُ عَنْھُمْ وَرَضُوْا عَنْهُ وَاَعَدَّ لَھُمْ جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِيْ تَحْتَهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَآ اَبَدًا ۭذٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيْمُ) (At-Tawbah: 100) 

Yaani awwal awwal sabqat karne wale Muhajir-o-Ansar aur unke baad ke woh log jo ehsaan mein unke mutabae hain Allah Ta'ala un sab se khush hai aur yeh sab Allah Ta'ala se raazi hain yani yeh baad ke log un aglo ke asaar-e-hasana aur awsaf-e-jameela ki ittiba karne wale aur unhe naik duaon se yaad rakhne wale hain goya zahir batin un ke tabe hain, is dua se Hazrat Imam Malik ؒ ne kitna pakeeza istadlal kiya hai ke Rafzi ko maal-e-fai se imam-e-waqt kuch na de kyunke woh Ashab-e-Rasool ﷺ ke liye dua karne ki bajaye unhe galiyan dete hain. 

Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa ؓ farmate hain ke in logo ko dekho kis tarah Quran ke khilaf karte hain Quran hukum deta hai ke Muhajir-o-Ansar ke liye duaein karo aur yeh galiyan dete hain phir yahi aayat Aap ne tilawat farmayi (Ibn Abi Hatim). 

Aur riwayat mein itna aur bhi hai ke maine tumhare Nabi ﷺ se suna hai ke yeh ummat khatam na hogi yahan tak ke unke pichle unke pehlo ko laanat karenge (Baghawi). 

Abu Dawood mein hai ke Hazrat Umar ne farmaya: 

(وَمَآ اَفَاۗءَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰي رَسُوْلِهٖ مِنْهُمْ فَمَآ اَوْجَفْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ خَيْلٍ وَّلَا رِكَابٍ وَّلٰكِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُسَلِّــطُ رُسُلَهٗ عَلٰي مَنْ يَّشَاۗءُ ۭ وَاللّٰهُ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ) (59)

(Al-Hashr: 6) mein jis maal-e-fai ka bayan hai woh toh khas Rasulullah ﷺ ka hai isi tarah uske baad ki (Ma afaa-allahu 'ala rasulihi min ahlil-qura falillahi wal-rasuli wa li-zil-qurba wal-yatama wal-masakini wabni-s-sabil. 59. (Al-Hashr: 7) wali ne aam kardiya hai tamam musalmanon ko is mein shamil kardiya hai ab ek musalman bhi aisa nahi jiska haq is maal mein na ho siwaye tumhare ghulamon ke, is hadith ki sanad mein intiqaa hai, Ibn Jarir mein hai Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A ne (Innama-s-sadaqatu lil-fuqara'i wal-masakini wal-'amilina 'alaiha wal-mu'allafati qulubuhum wa fi-r-riqabi wal-gharimina wa fi sabillahi wa ibni-s-sabilan fariqatan minallahu wallahu 'alimun hakim. 60. (At-Tawbah: 60) tak padh kar farmaya maal-e-zakat ke mustahiq toh yeh log hain phir (Wa'lamu annama ghanimtum min shai'in fa-anna lillahi khumusahu wal-rasuli wa li-zil-qurba wal-yatama wal-masakini wabni-s-sabil. 41. (Al-Anfal: 41) wali puri ayat ko padh kar farmaya maal-e-ghanimat ke mustahiq yeh log hain phir yeh (Ma afaa-allahu 'ala rasulihi min ahlil-qura falillahi wal-rasuli wa li-zil-qurba wal-yatama wal-masakini wabni-s-sabili kai la yakuna dulatam bainal-aghniya'i minkum wa ma atakumu-r-rasulu fakhudhuhu wa ma nahakum 'anhu fantahu wattaqullaha innal-laha shadidul-'iqab. 59. (Al-Hashr: 7) padh kar farmaya maal-e-fai ke mustahiqeen ko bayan farmate hue is ayat ne tamam musalmanon ko is maal-e-fai ka mustahiq kardiya hai, sab is ke mustahiq hain. Agar main zinda raha toh tum dekhoge ke gaon gothon ke charwaha ko bhi is ka hissa dunga jis ki peshani par is maal ke hasil karne ke liye pasina tak na aaya.))))

Mal-e-Fay ke haqdar: Upar bayan hua tha ke fay ka maal yani kafiron ka jo maal musalmano ke qabze mein maidan-e-jang mein lade bhade bagair agaya ho, uske malik Rasoolullah ﷺ hain. Phir aap yeh maal kise denge? Uska bayan ho raha hai ke iske haqdar woh gareeb muhajir hain jinhon ne Allah ko razi karne ke liye apni kaum ko naraz karliya, yahan tak ke unhein apna watan-e-aziz aur apne hath ka mushkilon se jama kiya hua maal waghera sab chhod chhad kar chal dena pada. Allah ke deen aur uske Rasool ﷺ ki madad mein barabar mashghool hain, Allah ke fazl-o-khushnudi ke mutalashi hain, yehi sachche log hain jinhon ne apna fe'l apne kaul ke mutabiq kar dikhaya, yeh ausaf sadat-e-muhajirin mein the ؓ. 

Phir Ansar ki madh bayan ho rahi hai aur unki fazilat, sharafat, karam aur buzurgi ka izhar ho raha hai, unki kushaada-deli, naik-nafsi, isar aur sakhawat ka zikr ho raha hai ke unhon ne muhajirin se pehle hi Dar-ul-Hijrat Madina mein apni bood-o-bash rakhi aur iman par qiyam rakha, muhajirin ke pahunchne se pehle hi yeh iman la chuke the balke bahut se muhajirin se bhi pehle yeh iman-dar ban gaye the. 

Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein is ayat ki tafsir ke mauqe par yeh riwayat hai ke Hazrat Umar ؓ ne farmaya: "Main apne baad ke khalifa kowasiyat karta hoon ke muhajirin-e-awaleen ke haq ada karta rahe, unki khatir-madarat mein kami na kare aur meri wasiyat hai ke Ansar ke sath bhi neki aur bhalai kare jinhon ne Madina mein jagah banai aur iman mein jagah hasil ki, unke bhale logon ki bhalaiyan qubul kare aur unki khataon se darguzar aur chashm-poshi karle." 

Unki sharafat-e-tab'i mulahiza ho ke jo bhi rah-e-Allah mein hijrat kar ke aaye yeh apne dil mein use ghar dete hain aur apna jaan-o-maal un par se nisar karna apna fakhr jante hain. 

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke muhajirin ne ek martaba kaha: "Ya Rasoolullah! Hum ne to duniya mein in Ansar jaise log nahi dekhe, thode mein se thoda aur bahut mein se bahut barabar hamein de rahe hain, muddaton se hamara kul kharch utha rahe hain balke naaz-bardariyan kar rahe hain aur kabhi chehre par shakan bhi nahi balke khidmat karte hain aur khush hote hain, dete hain aur ehsan nahi rakhte, kaam-kaaj khud karein aur kamai hamein dein."

Al-Hashr: 7] utri, Aan Hazrat ﷺ ne farmaya tumhare Muhajir bhai maal aur aulaad chhod kar tumhari taraf aate hain Ansar ne kaha phir Huzoor ﷺ hamara maal un mein aur hum mein barabar baant dijiye Aap ne farmaya is se bhi zyada Isaar kar sakte ho? Unhon ne kaha jo Huzoor ﷺ ka irshad ho Aap ne farmaya Muhajir khet aur baghaat ka kaam nahi jante tum aap apne maal ko qabza mein rakho khud kaam karo khud baghaat mein mehnat karo aur paidawar mein unhein shareeq kar do Ansar ne ise bhi ba-kushada peshani manzoor kar liya. Phir farmata hai ke khud ko haajat hone ke bawajood bhi apne doosre bhaiyon ki haajat ko muqaddam rakhte hain apni zaroorat khwah baqi reh jaye lekin doosre musalman ki zaroorat jald poori ho jaye yeh un ki har waqt ki khwahish hai, ek sahih hadis mein bhi hai ke jis ke paas kami aur qillat ho khud ko zaroorat ho aur phir bhi sad

Lekin aik kehta hai is doosre ko pilaao doosra kehta hai is teesre ko pehle pilaao woh abhi teesre tak pohancha bhi nahi ke aik shaheed hojata hai, doosre ko dekhta hai ke woh bhi pyaasa hi chal basa, teesre ke paas aata hai lekin dekhta hai ke woh bhi sookhe honton hi Allah se ja mila. Allah Ta'ala in buzurgon se khush ho aur unhein bhi apni zaat se khush rakhe. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke aik shakhs Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaya aur kaha Ya Rasulullah ﷺ main sakht haajat mand hoon mujhe kuch khilwaiye Aap ne apne gharon mein aadmi bheja lekin tamam gharon se jawab mila ke Huzoor ﷺ hamare paas khud kuch nahi yeh maloom kar ke phir Aap ne aur logon se kaha ke koi hai jo aaj ki raat unhein apna mehmaan rakhe? Aik Ansari uth khare hue aur kaha Huzoor ﷺ main unhein apna mehmaan rakhunga chunacha yeh le gaye aur apni biwi se kaha dekho yeh Rasulullah ﷺ ke mehmaan hain aaj go hamein kuch bhi khane ko na mile lekin yeh bhooke na rahein biwi sahiba ne kaha aaj ghar mein bhi barkat hai bachchon ke liye albata kuch tukre rakhe hue hain Ansari ne farmaya achcha bachchon ko to bhala phusla kar bhooka sula do aur hum tum dono apne pet par kapda baandh kar faaqe se raat guzaar denge, khate waqt chiragh bujha dena taake mehmaan yeh samjhe ke hum kha rahe hain aur darasal hum khayenge nahi. Chunacha aisa hi kiya subah jab yeh shakhs Ansari Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaye to Aap ne farmaya ke is shakhs ke aur is ki biwi ke raat ke amal se Allah Ta'ala khush hua aur hans diya inhi ke bare mein (Wa yu'thiroona 'ala anfusihim wa lau kana bihim khasasah) (Al-Hashr: 9) nazil hui, Sahih Muslim ki riwayat mein in Ansari ka naam hai Hazrat Abu Talha R.A. Phir farmata hai jo apne nafs ki bakhili hirs aur laalach se bach gaya us ne nijat pa li. Musnad Ahmad aur Muslim mein hai Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain logon zulm se bacho! Qayamat ke din yeh zulm andhera ban jayega logon bakhili aur hirs se bacho yahi woh cheez hai jis ne tum se pehle logon ko barbad kar diya isi ki wajah se unhein ne khoonriziyan keen aur haram ko halal bana liya aur sanad se yeh bhi marwi hai ke fahsh se bacho. Allah Ta'ala fahsh baaton aur behayai ke kaamon ko naپسند farmata hai, hirs aur bakhili ki mazammat mein yeh alfaaz bhi hain ke isi ke baais aglon ne zulm kiye fisq-o-fujoor kiye aur qat-e-rahmi ki. Abu Dawood waghera mein hai Allah ki rah ka ghubar aur jahannam ka dhuaan kisi bande ke pet mein jama ho hi nahi sakta isi tarah bakhili aur iman bhi kisi bande ke dil mein jama nahi ho sakte, yani rah-e-Allah ki gard jis par padi woh jahannam se azaad ho gaya aur jis ke dil mein bakhili ne ghar kar liya us ke dil mein iman ke rehne ki gunjaish hi nahi rehti, Hazrat Abdullah R.A ke paas aa kar aik shakhs ne kaha اے Abu Abdul Rahman main to halak ho gaya Aap ne farmaya kya baat hai?

Kaha Quran mein toh hai jo apne nafs ki bukhli se bacha diya gaya usne falah pali aur main toh maal ko bara rokne wala hoon, kharch karte hue dil rukta hai Aap ne farmaya is kunjusi ka zikr is aayat mein nahi yahan murad bukhli se yeh hai ke tu apne kisi musalman bhai ka maal zulm se kha jaye, haan bukhli ba-ma'ani kunjusi bhi hai bohat buri cheez hai (Ibn Abi Hatim). 

Hazrat Abu Lahiyaaj Asadi Rahimahullah Ta'ala Alaih farmate hain ke Baitullah ka tawaf karte hue maine dekha ke ek sahab sirf yahi dua parh rahe hain: (Dua: Allahumma qini shuhha nafsi) Ilahi mujhe mere nafs ki hirs o araz se bacha le aakhir mujhse na raha gaya maine kaha aap sirf yahi dua kyun maang rahe hain? Usne kaha jab is se bachao ho gaya toh phir na zina-kari ho sakegi na chori aur na koi bura kaam, ab jo maine dekha toh woh Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Awf the ؓ (Ibn Jarir). 

Ek hadith mein hai jis ne zakat ada ki aur mehmandari ki aur Allah ki rah ke zaroori kaamo mein diya woh apne nafs ki bukhli se door ho gaya, phir maal-e-fai ke mustahiq logo ki teesri qism ka bayan ho raha hai ke Ansar aur Muhajir ke fuqra ke baad unke tabe jo unke baad ke log hain un mein se masakeen bhi is maal ke mustahiq hain jo Allah Ta'ala se apne se agle ba-iman logo ke liye maghfirat ki duaein karte rehte hain jaise ke Surah Baraat mein hai: 

(وَالسّٰبِقُوْنَ الْاَوَّلُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُهٰجِرِيْنَ وَالْاَنْصَارِ وَالَّذِيْنَ اتَّبَعُوْھُمْ بِاِحْسَانٍ ۙ رَّضِيَ اللّٰهُ عَنْھُمْ وَرَضُوْا عَنْهُ وَاَعَدَّ لَھُمْ جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِيْ تَحْتَهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَآ اَبَدًا ۭذٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيْمُ) (At-Tawbah: 100) 

Yaani awwal awwal sabqat karne wale Muhajir-o-Ansar aur unke baad ke woh log jo ehsaan mein unke mutabae hain Allah Ta'ala un sab se khush hai aur yeh sab Allah Ta'ala se raazi hain yani yeh baad ke log un aglo ke asaar-e-hasana aur awsaf-e-jameela ki ittiba karne wale aur unhe naik duaon se yaad rakhne wale hain goya zahir batin un ke tabe hain, is dua se Hazrat Imam Malik ؒ ne kitna pakeeza istadlal kiya hai ke Rafzi ko maal-e-fai se imam-e-waqt kuch na de kyunke woh Ashab-e-Rasool ﷺ ke liye dua karne ki bajaye unhe galiyan dete hain. 

Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa ؓ farmate hain ke in logo ko dekho kis tarah Quran ke khilaf karte hain Quran hukum deta hai ke Muhajir-o-Ansar ke liye duaein karo aur yeh galiyan dete hain phir yahi aayat Aap ne tilawat farmayi (Ibn Abi Hatim). 

Aur riwayat mein itna aur bhi hai ke maine tumhare Nabi ﷺ se suna hai ke yeh ummat khatam na hogi yahan tak ke unke pichle unke pehlo ko laanat karenge (Baghawi). 

Abu Dawood mein hai ke Hazrat Umar ne farmaya: 

(وَمَآ اَفَاۗءَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰي رَسُوْلِهٖ مِنْهُمْ فَمَآ اَوْجَفْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ خَيْلٍ وَّلَا رِكَابٍ وَّلٰكِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُسَلِّــطُ رُسُلَهٗ عَلٰي مَنْ يَّشَاۗءُ ۭ وَاللّٰهُ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ) (59)

(Al-Hashr: 6) mein jis maal-e-fai ka bayan hai woh toh khas Rasulullah ﷺ ka hai isi tarah uske baad ki (Ma afaa-allahu 'ala rasulihi min ahlil-qura falillahi wal-rasuli wa li-zil-qurba wal-yatama wal-masakini wabni-s-sabil. 59. (Al-Hashr: 7) wali ne aam kardiya hai tamam musalmanon ko is mein shamil kardiya hai ab ek musalman bhi aisa nahi jiska haq is maal mein na ho siwaye tumhare ghulamon ke, is hadith ki sanad mein intiqaa hai, Ibn Jarir mein hai Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A ne (Innama-s-sadaqatu lil-fuqara'i wal-masakini wal-'amilina 'alaiha wal-mu'allafati qulubuhum wa fi-r-riqabi wal-gharimina wa fi sabillahi wa ibni-s-sabilan fariqatan minallahu wallahu 'alimun hakim. 60. (At-Tawbah: 60) tak padh kar farmaya maal-e-zakat ke mustahiq toh yeh log hain phir (Wa'lamu annama ghanimtum min shai'in fa-anna lillahi khumusahu wal-rasuli wa li-zil-qurba wal-yatama wal-masakini wabni-s-sabil. 41. (Al-Anfal: 41) wali puri ayat ko padh kar farmaya maal-e-ghanimat ke mustahiq yeh log hain phir yeh (Ma afaa-allahu 'ala rasulihi min ahlil-qura falillahi wal-rasuli wa li-zil-qurba wal-yatama wal-masakini wabni-s-sabili kai la yakuna dulatam bainal-aghniya'i minkum wa ma atakumu-r-rasulu fakhudhuhu wa ma nahakum 'anhu fantahu wattaqullaha innal-laha shadidul-'iqab. 59. (Al-Hashr: 7) padh kar farmaya maal-e-fai ke mustahiqeen ko bayan farmate hue is ayat ne tamam musalmanon ko is maal-e-fai ka mustahiq kardiya hai, sab is ke mustahiq hain. Agar main zinda raha toh tum dekhoge ke gaon gothon ke charwaha ko bhi is ka hissa dunga jis ki peshani par is maal ke hasil karne ke liye pasina tak na aaya.))))

Kufr baz-dili ki god hai, talbis-e-Iblees ka ek andaz: Abdullah bin Ubayy aur usi jaise munafiqeen ki chaal-bazi aur ayyari ka zikr ho raha hai ke unho ne Yahoodiyan-e-Banu Nazeer ko sabz baagh dikha kar, jhoota dilasa dila kar, ghalat wada kar ke musalmanon se lrhwa diya. Un se wada kiya ke hum tumhare sathi hain, lrhne mein tumhari madad karenge aur agar tum haar gaye aur Madina se des nikala mila to hum bhi tumhare sath is shehar ko chhor denge. Lekin buwaqt-e-wada hi efa karne ki niyat nah thi aur yeh bhi ke un mein itna hausla bhi nahi ke aisa kar saken, nah lrhai mein un ki madad kar saken, nah bure waqt un ka sath dein. Agar bad-nami ke khayal se maidan mein aa bhi jaane to yahan aate hi teez-o-talwar ki surat dekhte rongte khare ho jayenge aur namardi ke sath bhagte hi ban prega. Phir mustaqil tor par paish-goi farmata hai ke un ki tumhare muqable mein imdad nah ki jayegi, yeh Allah se bhi itna nahi drte jitna tum se khauf khate hain. Jaise aur jagah bhi hai: 
(Iza fareequn minhum yakhshawon-nasa kakhsyatil-lahi aw ashadda khsyah - 4. (An-Nisa: 77) 
 yaani un ka ek fareeq logon se itna drta hai jitna Allah se, balke is se bhi bohat zyada. Baat yeh hai ke yeh be-samajh log hain. Un ki namardi aur baz-dili ki yeh halat hai ke yeh maidan ki lrhai kabhi lrh nahi sakte. Han agar mazboot aur mehfooz qilon mein bethe hue hon ya morchon ki ar mein chup kar kuch karwai karne ka moqa ho to khair ba-sabab-e-zaroorat kar guzrenge, lekin maidan mein aa kar bahaduri ke johar dikhana yeh un se koson door hai. Yeh aapas hi mein ek doosre ke dushman hain, jaise aur jagah hai: 
(Wa yuzeeqa ba'dakum ba'sa ba'd - 6)

(Al-An'am: 65) Baaz ko baaz se laraayi ka maza chakhata hai, tum unhein mujtamih aur muttafiq-o-muttahid samajh rahe ho lekin darasal yeh mutafariq-o-mukhtalif hain ek ka dil doosre se nahi milta, munafiq apni jagah aur Ahl-e-Kitab apni jagah ek doosre ke dushman hain, wajah yeh hai ke be-aql log hain, phir farmaya unki misaal un se kuch hi pehle ke kafiron jaisi hai jinhone yahan bhi apne kiye ka badla bhugta aur wahan ka bhugtana abhi baqi hai, is se murad ya to kuffar-e-Quraish hain ke Badr wale din unki kamar kabri ho gayi aur sakht nuqsan utha kar kushton ke pushte chhor kar bhag khare hue, ya Bani Qainqa' ke Yahood hain ke woh bhi shararat par utar aaye Allah ne unhein apne Nabi ﷺ ko ghalib kiya aur Aap ne unhein Madina se kharij-ul-balad kara diya yeh dono waqie abhi abhi ke hain aur tumhari ibrat ka sahi sabaq hain lekin is waqt ke koi ibrat hasil karne wala anjam ko sochne wala ho bhi, zyada munasib maqam Bani Qainqa' ke Yahood ka waqia hi hai Wallahu A'lam, munafiqeen ke wadon par un Yahudiyon ka shararat par amada hona aur unke bhare mein aa kar muahda tor dalna phir un munafiqeen ka unhein mauqe par kaam na aana na laraayi ke waqt madad pohanchana na jala-watni mein sath dena, ek misaal se samjhaya jata hai ke dekho Shaitan bhi isi tarah insan ko kufr par amada karta hai aur jab yeh kufr kar chukta hai to khud bhi ise malamat karne lagta hai aur apna Allah wala hona zahir karne lagta hai, isi misaal ka ek waqia bhi sun lijiye, Bani Israel mein ek abid tha sath saal use ibadat-e-Ilahi mein guzar chuke the Shaitan ne use warghlana chaha lekin woh qaboo mein na aaya usne ek aurat par apna asar dala aur yeh zahir kiya ke goya ise jinnat sata rahe hain udhar us aurat ke bhaiyon ko yeh waswasa dala ke is ka ilaj isi abid se ho sakta hai yeh us aurat ko us abid ke pas laye usne ilaj mualija yaani dam karna shuru kiya aur yeh aurat yahin rehne lagi, ek din abid us ke pas hi tha ke Shaitan ne uske khayalat kharab karne shuru kiye yahan tak ke woh zina kar baitha aur woh aurat hamla ho gayi. Ab ruswai ke khauf se Shaitan ne chhutkare ki yeh surat batai ke is aurat ko maar dal varna raaz khul jayega. Chunancha usne ise qatal kar dala, udhar usne ja kar aurat ke bhaiyon ko shak dilaya woh dore aaye, Shaitan rahib ke pas aya aur kaha woh log aa rahe hain ab izzat bhi jayegi aur jan bhi jayegi. Agar mujhe khush kar le aur mera kaha maan le to izzat aur jan dono bach sakti hain.

Shaitaan ne kaha mujhe sajda kar, abid ne use sajda karliya, yeh kehne laga tuf hai tujh par kambakht main toh ab tujh se bezaar hoon main toh Allah Ta'ala se darta hoon, jo Rabb-ul-Alameen hai (Ibn Jareer). Ek aur riwayat mein is tarah hai ki ek aurat bakriyan charaya karti thi aur ek rahib ki khanqah tale raat guzara karti thi uske chaar bhai the ek din Shaitaan ne rahib ko gudgdaya aur us se zina kar baitha use haml reh gaya Shaitaan ne rahib ke dil mein dala ki ab badi ruswai hogi is se behtar yeh hai ki ise maar daal aur kahin dafn kar de tere taqaddus ko dekhte hue teri taraf toh kisi ka khayal bhi na jayega aur agar bilfarz phir bhi kuch pooch gach ho toh jhoot moot keh dena, bhala kaun hai jo teri baat ko ghalat jaane? Uski samajh mein bhi yeh baat aagayi, ek roz raat ke waqt mauqa pa kar us aurat ko jaan se maar dala aur kisi ujaad jagah zameen mein daba diya. Ab Shaitaan uske chaaron bhaiyon ke paas pahuncha aur har ek ke khwab mein use sara waqia keh sunaya aur uske dafn ki jagah bhi bata di, subah jab yeh jaage toh ek ne kaha aaj ki raat toh main ne ek ajeeb khwab dekha hai himmat nahi padti ki aap se bayaan karoon doosron ne kaha nahi kaho toh sahi chunacha usne apna poora khwab bayaan kiya ki is tarah falan abid ne us se badkari ki phir jab haml thehar gaya toh ise qatl kardiya aur falan jagah uski lash daba aya hai, un teenon mein se har ek ne kaha mujhe bhi yehi khwab aya hai ab toh unhe yaqeen hogaya ki sacha khwab hai, chunacha unhone ja kar itlaa di aur baadshah ke hukm se us rahib ko us khanqah se sath liya aur us jagah pahunch kar zameen khod kar uski lash baramad ki, kamil suboot ke baad ab use shahi darbar mein le chale us waqt Shaitaan uske samne zahir hota hai aur kehta hai yeh sab mere kartoot hain ab bhi agar toh mujhe raazi karle toh jaan bacha doon ga usne kaha jo toh kahe karoon ga, kaha mujhe sajda karle usne yeh bhi kardiya, pas poora be-imaan bana kar Shaitaan kehta hai main toh tujh se bari hoon main toh Allah Ta'ala se jo tamam jahano ka rab hai darta hoon, chunacha baadshah ne hukm diya aur paadri sahib ko qatl kardiya gaya, mashhoor hai ki us paadri ka naam Barseesah tha. Hazrat Ali R.A, Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A, Tawoos, Muqatil bin Hayyan waghera se yeh qissa mukhtalif alfaaz ke sath kami beshi ke sath marwi hai, Wallahu A'lam. Uske bilkul bar-aks Juraij abid ka qissa hai ki ek badkar aurat ne us par tohmat laga di ki usne mere sath zina kiya hai aur yeh bacha jo mujhe hua hai woh usi ka hai chunacha logon ne Hazrat Juraij ke ibadat khane ko gher liya aur unhe nihayat be-adbi se zad-o-kob karte hue gaaliyan dete hue bahar le aaye aur ibadat khane ko dha diya yeh bechare ghabraye hue harchand poochte hain ki aakhir waqia kya hai? Lekin majma aape se bahar hai aakhir kisi ne kaha ki Allah ke dushman Awliyaullah ke libas mein yeh shaitani harkat? Us aurat se toh ne badkari ki.

Hazrat Jurij ne farmaya acha tehro sabr karo is bachche ko lao chunache woh doodh peeta chhota sa bachcha laya gaya. Hazrat Jurij ne apni izzat ki baqa ki Allah se dua ki phir us bachche se poochha, "Aaye bachche bata tera baap kaun hai?" Is bachche ko Allah ne apne wali ki izzat bachane ke liye apni qudrat se goyayi ki quwwat ata farma di aur us ne is saaf faseeh zuban mein oonchi aawaz se kaha, "Mera baap ek charwaha hai." Yeh sunte hi Bani Israel ke hosh jaate rahe, yeh us buzurg ke samne uzr-o-mazrat karne lage, maafi mangne lage. Unhon ne kaha, "Bas ab mujhe chhod do." Logon ne kaha, "Hum aap ki abid-gah sone ki bana dete hain." Aap ne farmaya, "Bas ise jaisi woh thi waise hi rehne do." Phir farmata hai ke aakhir anjam kufr ke karne aur hukum dene wale ka yahi hua ke dono hamesha ke liye jahannam wasil hue, har zalim kiye ki saza pa hi leta hai.)

Ek aur riwayat mein is tarah hai ki ek aurat bakriyan charaya karti thi aur ek rahib ki khanqah tale raat guzara karti thi uske chaar bhai the ek din Shaitaan ne rahib ko gudgdaya aur us se zina kar baitha use haml reh gaya Shaitaan ne rahib ke dil mein dala ki ab badi ruswai hogi is se behtar yeh hai ki ise maar daal aur kahin dafn kar de tere taqaddus ko dekhte hue teri taraf toh kisi ka khayal bhi na jayega aur agar bilfarz phir bhi kuch pooch gach ho toh jhoot moot keh dena, bhala kaun hai jo teri baat ko ghalat jaane? Uski samajh mein bhi yeh baat aagayi, ek roz raat ke waqt mauqa pa kar us aurat ko jaan se maar dala aur kisi ujaad jagah zameen mein daba diya. Ab Shaitaan uske chaaron bhaiyon ke paas pahuncha aur har ek ke khwab mein use sara waqia keh sunaya aur uske dafn ki jagah bhi bata di, subah jab yeh jaage toh ek ne kaha aaj ki raat toh main ne ek ajeeb khwab dekha hai himmat nahi padti ki aap se bayaan karoon doosron ne kaha nahi kaho toh sahi chunacha usne apna poora khwab bayaan kiya ki is tarah falan abid ne us se badkari ki phir jab haml thehar gaya toh ise qatl kardiya aur falan jagah uski lash daba aya hai, un teenon mein se har ek ne kaha mujhe bhi yehi khwab aya hai ab toh unhe yaqeen hogaya ki sacha khwab hai, chunacha unhone ja kar itlaa di aur baadshah ke hukm se us rahib ko us khanqah se sath liya aur us jagah pahunch kar zameen khod kar uski lash baramad ki, kamil suboot ke baad ab use shahi darbar mein le chale us waqt Shaitaan uske samne zahir hota hai aur kehta hai yeh sab mere kartoot hain ab bhi agar toh mujhe raazi karle toh jaan bacha doon ga usne kaha jo toh kahe karoon ga, kaha mujhe sajda karle usne yeh bhi kardiya, pas poora be-imaan bana kar Shaitaan kehta hai main toh tujh se bari hoon main toh Allah Ta'ala se jo tamam jahano ka rab hai darta hoon, chunacha baadshah ne hukm diya aur paadri sahib ko qatl kardiya gaya, mashhoor hai ki us paadri ka naam Barseesah tha. Hazrat Ali R.A, Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A, Tawoos, Muqatil bin Hayyan waghera se yeh qissa mukhtalif alfaaz ke sath kami beshi ke sath marwi hai, Wallahu A'lam. Uske bilkul bar-aks Juraij abid ka qissa hai ki ek badkar aurat ne us par tohmat laga di ki usne mere sath zina kiya hai aur yeh bacha jo mujhe hua hai woh usi ka hai chunacha logon ne Hazrat Juraij ke ibadat khane ko gher liya aur unhe nihayat be-adbi se zad-o-kob karte hue gaaliyan dete hue bahar le aaye aur ibadat khane ko dha diya yeh bechare ghabraye hue harchand poochte hain ki aakhir waqia kya hai? Lekin majma aape se bahar hai aakhir kisi ne kaha ki Allah ke dushman Awliyaullah ke libas mein yeh shaitani harkat? Us aurat se toh ne badkari ki.

Hazrat Jurij ne apni izzat ki baqa ki Allah se dua ki phir us bachche se poochha, "Aaye bachche bata tera baap kaun hai?" Yeh sunte hi Bani Israel ke hosh jaate rahe, yeh us buzurg ke samne uzr-o-mazrat karne lage, maafi mangne lage. Unhon ne kaha, "Bas ab mujhe chhod do." Logon ne kaha, "Hum aap ki abid-gah sone ki bana dete hain." Aap ne farmaya, "Bas ise jaisi woh thi waise hi rehne do." Phir farmata hai ke aakhir anjam kufr ke karne aur hukum dene wale ka yahi hua ke dono hamesha ke liye jahannam wasil hue, har zalim kiye ki saza pa hi leta hai.)

Logon ne kaha, "Hum aap ki abid-gah sone ki bana dete hain." Aap ne farmaya, "Bas ise jaisi woh thi waise hi rehne do." Kufr baz-dili ki god hai, talbis-e-Iblees ka ek andaz: Abdullah bin Ubayy aur usi jaise munafiqeen ki chaal-bazi aur ayyari ka zikr ho raha hai ke unho ne Yahoodiyan-e-Banu Nazeer ko sabz baagh dikha kar, jhoota dilasa dila kar, ghalat wada kar ke musalmanon se lrhwa diya. Un se wada kiya ke hum tumhare sathi hain, lrhne mein tumhari madad karenge aur agar tum haar gaye aur Madina se des nikala mila to hum bhi tumhare sath is shehar ko chhor denge. Lekin buwaqt-e-wada hi efa karne ki niyat nah thi aur yeh bhi ke un mein itna hausla bhi nahi ke aisa kar saken, nah lrhai mein un ki madad kar saken, nah bure waqt un ka sath dein. Agar bad-nami ke khayal se maidan mein aa bhi jaane to yahan aate hi teez-o-talwar ki surat dekhte rongte khare ho jayenge aur namardi ke sath bhagte hi ban prega. Phir mustaqil tor par paish-goi farmata hai ke un ki tumhare muqable mein imdad nah ki jayegi, yeh Allah se bhi itna nahi drte jitna tum se khauf khate hain. Jaise aur jagah bhi hai: 
(Iza fareequn minhum yakhshawon-nasa kakhsyatil-lahi aw ashadda khsyah - 4. (An-Nisa: 77) 
 yaani un ka ek fareeq logon se itna drta hai jitna Allah se, balke is se bhi bohat zyada. Baat yeh hai ke yeh be-samajh log hain. Un ki namardi aur baz-dili ki yeh halat hai ke yeh maidan ki lrhai kabhi lrh nahi sakte. Han agar mazboot aur mehfooz qilon mein bethe hue hon ya morchon ki ar mein chup kar kuch karwai karne ka moqa ho to khair ba-sabab-e-zaroorat kar guzrenge, lekin maidan mein aa kar bahaduri ke johar dikhana yeh un se koson door hai. Yeh aapas hi mein ek doosre ke dushman hain, jaise aur jagah hai: 
(Wa yuzeeqa ba'dakum ba'sa ba'd - 6)

(Al-An'am: 65) Baaz ko baaz se laraayi ka maza chakhata hai, tum unhein mujtamih aur muttafiq-o-muttahid samajh rahe ho lekin darasal yeh mutafariq-o-mukhtalif hain ek ka dil doosre se nahi milta, munafiq apni jagah aur Ahl-e-Kitab apni jagah ek doosre ke dushman hain, wajah yeh hai ke be-aql log hain, phir farmaya unki misaal un se kuch hi pehle ke kafiron jaisi hai jinhone yahan bhi apne kiye ka badla bhugta aur wahan ka bhugtana abhi baqi hai, is se murad ya to kuffar-e-Quraish hain ke Badr wale din unki kamar kabri ho gayi aur sakht nuqsan utha kar kushton ke pushte chhor kar bhag khare hue, ya Bani Qainqa' ke Yahood hain ke woh bhi shararat par utar aaye Allah ne unhein apne Nabi ﷺ ko ghalib kiya aur Aap ne unhein Madina se kharij-ul-balad kara diya yeh dono waqie abhi abhi ke hain aur tumhari ibrat ka sahi sabaq hain lekin is waqt ke koi ibrat hasil karne wala anjam ko sochne wala ho bhi, zyada munasib maqam Bani Qainqa' ke Yahood ka waqia hi hai Wallahu A'lam, munafiqeen ke wadon par un Yahudiyon ka shararat par amada hona aur unke bhare mein aa kar muahda tor dalna phir un munafiqeen ka unhein mauqe par kaam na aana na laraayi ke waqt madad pohanchana na jala-watni mein sath dena, ek misaal se samjhaya jata hai ke dekho Shaitan bhi isi tarah insan ko kufr par amada karta hai aur jab yeh kufr kar chukta hai to khud bhi ise malamat karne lagta hai aur apna Allah wala hona zahir karne lagta hai, isi misaal ka ek waqia bhi sun lijiye, Bani Israel mein ek abid tha sath saal use ibadat-e-Ilahi mein guzar chuke the Shaitan ne use warghlana chaha lekin woh qaboo mein na aaya usne ek aurat par apna asar dala aur yeh zahir kiya ke goya ise jinnat sata rahe hain udhar us aurat ke bhaiyon ko yeh waswasa dala ke is ka ilaj isi abid se ho sakta hai yeh us aurat ko us abid ke pas laye usne ilaj mualija yaani dam karna shuru kiya aur yeh aurat yahin rehne lagi, ek din abid us ke pas hi tha ke Shaitan ne uske khayalat kharab karne shuru kiye yahan tak ke woh zina kar baitha aur woh aurat hamla ho gayi. Ab ruswai ke khauf se Shaitan ne chhutkare ki yeh surat batai ke is aurat ko maar dal varna raaz khul jayega. Agar mujhe khush kar le aur mera kaha maan le to izzat aur jan dono bach sakti hain.

(Al-An'am: 65) Baaz ko baaz se laraayi ka maza chakhata hai, tum unhein mujtamih aur muttafiq-o-muttahid samajh rahe ho lekin darasal yeh mutafariq-o-mukhtalif hain ek ka dil doosre se nahi milta, munafiq apni jagah aur Ahl-e-Kitab apni jagah ek doosre ke dushman hain, wajah yeh hai ke be-aql log hain, phir farmaya unki misaal un se kuch hi pehle ke kafiron jaisi hai jinhone yahan bhi apne kiye ka badla bhugta aur wahan ka bhugtana abhi baqi hai, is se murad ya to kuffar-e-Quraish hain ke Badr wale din unki kamar kabri ho gayi aur sakht nuqsan utha kar kushton ke pushte chhor kar bhag khare hue, ya Bani Qainqa' ke Yahood hain ke woh bhi shararat par utar aaye Allah ne unhein apne Nabi ﷺ ko ghalib kiya aur Aap ne unhein Madina se kharij-ul-balad kara diya yeh dono waqie abhi abhi ke hain aur tumhari ibrat ka sahi sabaq hain lekin is waqt ke koi ibrat hasil karne wala anjam ko sochne wala ho bhi, zyada munasib maqam Bani Qainqa' ke Yahood ka waqia hi hai Wallahu A'lam, munafiqeen ke wadon par un Yahudiyon ka shararat par amada hona aur unke bhare mein aa kar muahda tor dalna phir un munafiqeen ka unhein mauqe par kaam na aana na laraayi ke waqt madad pohanchana na jala-watni mein sath dena, ek misaal se samjhaya jata hai ke dekho Shaitan bhi isi tarah insan ko kufr par amada karta hai aur jab yeh kufr kar chukta hai to khud bhi ise malamat karne lagta hai aur apna Allah wala hona zahir karne lagta hai, isi misaal ka ek waqia bhi sun lijiye, Bani Israel mein ek abid tha sath saal use ibadat-e-Ilahi mein guzar chuke the Shaitan ne use warghlana chaha lekin woh qaboo mein na aaya usne ek aurat par apna asar dala aur yeh zahir kiya ke goya ise jinnat sata rahe hain udhar us aurat ke bhaiyon ko yeh waswasa dala ke is ka ilaj isi abid se ho sakta hai yeh us aurat ko us abid ke pas laye usne ilaj mualija yaani dam karna shuru kiya aur yeh aurat yahin rehne lagi, ek din abid us ke pas hi tha ke Shaitan ne uske khayalat kharab karne shuru kiye yahan tak ke woh zina kar baitha aur woh aurat hamla ho gayi. Ab ruswai ke khauf se Shaitan ne chhutkare ki yeh surat batai ke is aurat ko maar dal varna raaz khul jayega. Chunancha usne ise qatal kar dala, udhar usne ja kar aurat ke bhaiyon ko shak dilaya woh dore aaye, Shaitan rahib ke pas aya aur kaha woh log aa rahe hain ab izzat bhi jayegi aur jan bhi jayegi. Agar mujhe khush kar le aur mera kaha maan le to izzat aur jan dono bach sakti hain.

Shaitaan ne kaha mujhe sajda kar, abid ne use sajda karliya, yeh kehne laga tuf hai tujh par kambakht main toh ab tujh se bezaar hoon main toh Allah Ta'ala se darta hoon, jo Rabb-ul-Alameen hai (Ibn Jareer). Ek aur riwayat mein is tarah hai ki ek aurat bakriyan charaya karti thi aur ek rahib ki khanqah tale raat guzara karti thi uske chaar bhai the ek din Shaitaan ne rahib ko gudgdaya aur us se zina kar baitha use haml reh gaya Shaitaan ne rahib ke dil mein dala ki ab badi ruswai hogi is se behtar yeh hai ki ise maar daal aur kahin dafn kar de tere taqaddus ko dekhte hue teri taraf toh kisi ka khayal bhi na jayega aur agar bilfarz phir bhi kuch pooch gach ho toh jhoot moot keh dena, bhala kaun hai jo teri baat ko ghalat jaane? Uski samajh mein bhi yeh baat aagayi, ek roz raat ke waqt mauqa pa kar us aurat ko jaan se maar dala aur kisi ujaad jagah zameen mein daba diya. Ab Shaitaan uske chaaron bhaiyon ke paas pahuncha aur har ek ke khwab mein use sara waqia keh sunaya aur uske dafn ki jagah bhi bata di, subah jab yeh jaage toh ek ne kaha aaj ki raat toh main ne ek ajeeb khwab dekha hai himmat nahi padti ki aap se bayaan karoon doosron ne kaha nahi kaho toh sahi chunacha usne apna poora khwab bayaan kiya ki is tarah falan abid ne us se badkari ki phir jab haml thehar gaya toh ise qatl kardiya aur falan jagah uski lash daba aya hai, un teenon mein se har ek ne kaha mujhe bhi yehi khwab aya hai ab toh unhe yaqeen hogaya ki sacha khwab hai, chunacha unhone ja kar itlaa di aur baadshah ke hukm se us rahib ko us khanqah se sath liya aur us jagah pahunch kar zameen khod kar uski lash baramad ki, kamil suboot ke baad ab use shahi darbar mein le chale us waqt Shaitaan uske samne zahir hota hai aur kehta hai yeh sab mere kartoot hain ab bhi agar toh mujhe raazi karle toh jaan bacha doon ga usne kaha jo toh kahe karoon ga, kaha mujhe sajda karle usne yeh bhi kardiya, pas poora be-imaan bana kar Shaitaan kehta hai main toh tujh se bari hoon main toh Allah Ta'ala se jo tamam jahano ka rab hai darta hoon, chunacha baadshah ne hukm diya aur paadri sahib ko qatl kardiya gaya, mashhoor hai ki us paadri ka naam Barseesah tha. Hazrat Ali R.A, Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A, Tawoos, Muqatil bin Hayyan waghera se yeh qissa mukhtalif alfaaz ke sath kami beshi ke sath marwi hai, Wallahu A'lam. Uske bilkul bar-aks Juraij abid ka qissa hai ki ek badkar aurat ne us par tohmat laga di ki usne mere sath zina kiya hai aur yeh bacha jo mujhe hua hai woh usi ka hai chunacha logon ne Hazrat Juraij ke ibadat khane ko gher liya aur unhe nihayat be-adbi se zad-o-kob karte hue gaaliyan dete hue bahar le aaye aur ibadat khane ko dha diya yeh bechare ghabraye hue harchand poochte hain ki aakhir waqia kya hai? Lekin majma aape se bahar hai aakhir kisi ne kaha ki Allah ke dushman Awliyaullah ke libas mein yeh shaitani harkat? Us aurat se toh ne badkari ki.

Hazrat Jurij ne farmaya acha tehro sabr karo is bachche ko lao chunache woh doodh peeta chhota sa bachcha laya gaya. Hazrat Jurij ne apni izzat ki baqa ki Allah se dua ki phir us bachche se poochha, "Aaye bachche bata tera baap kaun hai?" Is bachche ko Allah ne apne wali ki izzat bachane ke liye apni qudrat se goyayi ki quwwat ata farma di aur us ne is saaf faseeh zuban mein oonchi aawaz se kaha, "Mera baap ek charwaha hai." Yeh sunte hi Bani Israel ke hosh jaate rahe, yeh us buzurg ke samne uzr-o-mazrat karne lage, maafi mangne lage. Unhon ne kaha, "Bas ab mujhe chhod do." Logon ne kaha, "Hum aap ki abid-gah sone ki bana dete hain." Aap ne farmaya, "Bas ise jaisi woh thi waise hi rehne do." Phir farmata hai ke aakhir anjam kufr ke karne aur hukum dene wale ka yahi hua ke dono hamesha ke liye jahannam wasil hue, har zalim kiye ki saza pa hi leta hai.)

Ijtima'i aur khair ki ek nauyat aur infradi aamal-e-khair Hazrat Jarir R.A farmate hain ke hum din charhe Rasoolullah ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir the ke kuch log aaye jo nange badan aur khale pair thay. Sirf chadoron ya abaon se badan chupaye hue talwaren gardanon mein hamail kiye hue thay yeh tamam log qabila Mudar mein se thay, un ki is faqr-o-faqa ki halat ne Rasoolullah ﷺ ke chehre ki rangat ko mutaghayir kar diya, Aap ghar mein gaye phir bahar aaye phir Hazrat Bilal ko azan kehne ka hukm diya azan hui phir iqamat hui Aap ne namaz parhai phir khutba shuru kiya aur ayat (tarjuma) al-kh, tilawat ki phir Surah Hashr ki ayat (tarjuma) al-kh, parhi aur logon ko khairat dene ki raghbat dilai jis par logon ne sadqa dena shuru kiya bohat se dirham dinar kapre latte khajoorain waghera aa gain Aap barabar taqreen kiye jate thay yahan tak ke farmaya agar aadhe khajoor bhi de sakte ho to le aao, ek Ansari ek thaili naqdi ki bhari hui bohat wazni jise b-mushkil utha sakte thay le aaye phir to logon ne lagatar jo kuch paya lana shuru kar diya yahan tak ke har cheez ke dhair lag gaye aur Huzoor ﷺ ka udas chehra bohat khul gaya aur misl sone ke chamakne laga aur Aap ne farmaya jo bhi kisi islami kar-e-khair ko shuru kare use apna bhi aur us ke baad jo bhi is kaam ko karen sab ka badla milta hai lekin baad walon ke ajr ghat kar nahin, isi tarah jo Islam mein kisi bure aur khilaf shuru tareeqe ko jari kare us par is ka apna gunah bhi hota hai aur phir jitne log us par karband hon sab ko jitna gunah milega utna hi ise bhi milta hai magar un ke gunah ghatte nahin (Muslim). Ayat mein pehle hukm hota hai ke Allah Ta'ala ke azab se bachao ki surat paida karo yaani us ke ahkam baja la kar aur us ki nafarmaniyon se bach kar, phir farman hai ke waqt se pehle apna hisab aap liya karo dekhte raho ke Qiyamat ke din jab Allah ke samne pesh hoge tab kaam aane wale naik aamal ka kitna kuch zakhira tumhare paas hai, phir تاکید (takeed) irshad hota hai ke Allah Ta'ala se darte raha karo aur jaan rakho ke tumhare tamam aamal-o-ahwal se Allah Ta'ala poora ba-khabar hai na koi chhota kaam is se poshida na bara na chhupa na khula. Phir farman hai ke Allah ke zikr ko na bhulo warna woh tumhare naik aamal jo akhirat mein nafa dene wale hain bhula dega is liye ke har amal ka badla usi ke jins se hota hai isi liye farmaya ke yahi log fasiq hain yaani Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at se nikal jane wale aur Qiyamat ke din nuqsan pohnchane wale aur halakat mein parne wale yahi log hain, jaise aur jagah irshad hai. (Tarjuma) Musalmano! Tumhen tumhare maal-o-aulad yad-e-Allah se ghafil na karen jo aisa karen woh sakht ziyan-kar hain, Tabarani mein Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique R.A ke ek khutba ka mukhtasar sa hissa yeh manqool hai ke Aap ne farmaya, kya tum nahi jante?

Keh subh-o-sham tum apne muqarrara waqt ki taraf barh rahe ho, pas tumhein chahiye keh apni zindagi ke auqat Allah Azz-o-Jal ki farmanbardari mein guzaro, aur is maqsad ko siwaye Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam ke koi shakhs sirf apni taqat-o-quwwat se hasil nahin kar sakta, jin logon ne apni umar Allah Ta'ala ki razamandi ke siwa aur kamon mein khapai un jaise tum na hona, Allah Ta'ala ne tumhein un jaise banne se mana farmaya hai. (Tarjuma) Khayal karo keh tumhari jaan pehchan ke tumhare bhai aaj kahan hain? Unhon ne apne guzashta ayyam mein jo aamal kiye thay un ka badla lene ya un ki saza pane ke liye woh darbar-e-Ilahi mein ja pohanche, ya to unhon ne sa'adat aur khush-naseebi pai ya namuradi aur shaqawat hasil karli, kahan hain? Woh sarkash log jinhon ne baronaq shehar basaye aur un ke mazboot qil'e khare kiye, aaj woh qabron ke garhon mein pathron tale dabay pare hain, yeh hai Kitabullah Quran-e-Kareem tum is noor se roshni hasil karo jo tumhein Qayamat ke din ki andheron mein kaam aa sake, is ki khoobi bayan se ibrat hasil karo aur ban sanwar jao, dekho Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Zakariya A.S aur un ki Ahl-e-Bait ki tareef bayan karte hue farmaya (Tarjuma) yani woh nek kamon mein sabqat karte thay aur bare lalach aur sakht khauf ke sath hum se duayein kiya karte thay aur hamare samne jhuke jate thay, suno woh baat bhalai se khali hai jis se Allah ki razamandi maqsood na ho, woh maal khair-o-barkat wala nahin jo Allah ki rah mein kharch na kiya jata ho, woh shakhs nek-bakhti se door hai jis ki jahalat bardbari par ghalib ho is tarah woh shakhs bhi neki se khali hath hai jo Allah ke ahkaam ki tameel mein kisi malamat karne wale ki malamat se khauf khaye. Is ki asnaad bohat umda hain aur is ke rawi siqa hain, go is ke ek rawi Na'eem bin Namha siqahat ya adam-e-siqahat se ma'roof nahin, lekin Imam Abu Dawood Sajistani R.H ka yeh faisla kafi hai keh Jareer bin Usman ke tamam ustad siqa hain aur yeh bhi aap hi ke asatiza mein se hain aur is khutba ke aur shawahid bhi marwi hain, Wallahu A'lam. Phir irshad hota hai keh jahannami aur jannati Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek yaksan nahin, jaise farman hai (Tarjuma) Al-kh, yani kya badkaron ne yeh samajh rakha hai keh hum unhein ba-iman nek-kar logon ke misl kardein ge un ka jeena aur marna yaksan hai un ka yeh da'wa bilkul ghalat aur bura hai aur jagah hai (Tarjuma) Al-kh, andha aur dekhta imandar saleh aur badkar barabar nahin, tum bohat hi kam nasihat hasil kar rahe ho, aur (Tarjuma) Al-kh kya hum iman lane aur nek aamal karne walon ko fasad karne walon jaisa banadein ge ya parhezgaron ko misl fajiron ke banadein ge? Aur bhi is mazmoon ki bohat si ayatein hain, matlab yeh hai keh nek-kar logon ka ikram hoga aur badkar logon ko ruswa kun azab hoga.

Yahan bhi irshad hota hai ke jannati log faiz-e-bamaram aur maqsood-o-ma'arof, kamyab aur falah-o-najat yafta hain Allah Azzawajal ke azaab se baal baal bach jayenge.

Keh subh-o-sham tum apne muqarrara waqt ki taraf barh rahe ho, pas tumhein chahiye keh apni zindagi ke auqat Allah Azz-o-Jal ki farmanbardari mein guzaro, aur is maqsad ko siwaye Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam ke koi shakhs sirf apni taqat-o-quwwat se hasil nahin kar sakta, jin logon ne apni umar Allah Ta'ala ki razamandi ke siwa aur kamon mein khapai un jaise tum na hona, Allah Ta'ala ne tumhein un jaise banne se mana farmaya hai. (Tarjuma) Khayal karo keh tumhari jaan pehchan ke tumhare bhai aaj kahan hain? Unhon ne apne guzashta ayyam mein jo aamal kiye thay un ka badla lene ya un ki saza pane ke liye woh darbar-e-Ilahi mein ja pohanche, ya to unhon ne sa'adat aur khush-naseebi pai ya namuradi aur shaqawat hasil karli, kahan hain? Woh sarkash log jinhon ne baronaq shehar basaye aur un ke mazboot qil'e khare kiye, aaj woh qabron ke garhon mein pathron tale dabay pare hain, yeh hai Kitabullah Quran-e-Kareem tum is noor se roshni hasil karo jo tumhein Qayamat ke din ki andheron mein kaam aa sake, is ki khoobi bayan se ibrat hasil karo aur ban sanwar jao, dekho Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Zakariya A.S aur un ki Ahl-e-Bait ki tareef bayan karte hue farmaya (Tarjuma) yani woh nek kamon mein sabqat karte thay aur bare lalach aur sakht khauf ke sath hum se duayein kiya karte thay aur hamare samne jhuke jate thay, suno woh baat bhalai se khali hai jis se Allah ki razamandi maqsood na ho, woh maal khair-o-barkat wala nahin jo Allah ki rah mein kharch na kiya jata ho, woh shakhs nek-bakhti se door hai jis ki jahalat bardbari par ghalib ho is tarah woh shakhs bhi neki se khali hath hai jo Allah ke ahkaam ki tameel mein kisi malamat karne wale ki malamat se khauf khaye. Is ki asnaad bohat umda hain aur is ke rawi siqa hain, go is ke ek rawi Na'eem bin Namha siqahat ya adam-e-siqahat se ma'roof nahin, lekin Imam Abu Dawood Sajistani R.H ka yeh faisla kafi hai keh Jareer bin Usman ke tamam ustad siqa hain aur yeh bhi aap hi ke asatiza mein se hain aur is khutba ke aur shawahid bhi marwi hain, Wallahu A'lam. Phir irshad hota hai keh jahannami aur jannati Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek yaksan nahin, jaise farman hai (Tarjuma) Al-kh, yani kya badkaron ne yeh samajh rakha hai keh hum unhein ba-iman nek-kar logon ke misl kardein ge un ka jeena aur marna yaksan hai un ka yeh da'wa bilkul ghalat aur bura hai aur jagah hai (Tarjuma) Al-kh, andha aur dekhta imandar saleh aur badkar barabar nahin, tum bohat hi kam nasihat hasil kar rahe ho, aur (Tarjuma) Al-kh kya hum iman lane aur nek aamal karne walon ko fasad karne walon jaisa banadein ge ya parhezgaron ko misl fajiron ke banadein ge? Aur bhi is mazmoon ki bohat si ayatein hain, matlab yeh hai keh nek-kar logon ka ikram hoga aur badkar logon ko ruswa kun azab hoga.

Yahan bhi irshad hota hai ke jannati log faiz-e-bamaram aur maqsood-o-ma'arof, kamyab aur falah-o-najat yafta hain Allah Azzawajal ke azaab se baal baal bach jayenge.

Buland-o-Azeem Martaba Quran-e-Majeed. Quran-e-Kareem ki buzurgi bayaan ho rahi hai ke fi-waqai yeh paak kitaab is qadar buland martaba hai ke dil is ke samne jhuk jayen, rongte khare hojayen, kaleje kapkapayen, is ke sachche waade aur is ki haqani dant dapt har sunne wale ko bed ki tarah thurade, aur darbar-e-Allah mein sare-e-sujood kara de, agar yeh Quran janab-e-Bari kisi sakht buland aur unche pahaar par bhi nazil farmata aur ise ghaur-o-fikr aur fehm-o-farasat ki hiss bhi deta toh woh bhi Allah ke khouf se reza reza hojata, phir insanon ke dilon par jo nisbatan bahut narm aur chhote hain, jinhein poori samajh bojh hai, is ka bahut bara asar parna chahiye, in misalon ko logon ke samne un ke ghaur-o-fikr ke liye Allah Ta'ala ne bayaan farma diya, matlab yeh hai ke insanon ko bhi dar aur aajizi chahiye, mutawatir hadith mein hai ke mimbar tayyar hone se pehle Rasool Allah ﷺ ek khajoor ke tane par tek laga kar khutba parha karte the jab mimbar ban gaya, bich gaya aur Huzoor ﷺ us par khutba parhne ko khare hue aur woh tana door hogaya, toh us mein se rane ki aawaz aane lagi aur is tarah siskiyan le le kar woh rane laga jaise koi bachcha bilak bilak kar rota ho aur ise chup karaya ja raha ho kyunke woh zikr-e-wahi ke sunne se kuch door hogaya tha. Imam Basri is hadith ko bayaan kar ke farmate the ke " Logo ek khajoor ka tana is qadar Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ka shaiq ho toh tumhe chahiye ke is se bahut zyada shauq aur chahat tum rakho. " Isi tarah ki yeh aayat hai ke " Jab ek pahaar ka yeh haal ho toh tumhe chahiye ke tum toh is halat mein is se aage raho " aur jagah farman-e-Allah hai (tarjumah) yani agar koi Quran aisa hota ke us ke bais pahaar chala diye jayen ya zameen kaat di jaye ya murde bol parin (toh us ke qabil yehi Quran tha) (magar phir bhi in kuffar ko iman naseeb na hota) aur jagah farman-e-Aali Shan hai (tarjumah) al-kh, yani baaz patthar aise hain jin mein se nahrein bah nikalti hain baaz woh hain ke phat jaate hain aur un mein se pani nikalta hai baaz Allah ke khouf se gir parte hain. Phir farmata hai Allah Ta'ala ke siva na toh koi palne aur parwarish karne wala hai, na us ke siva kisi ki aisi nishaniyan hain ke us ki kisi qism ki ibadat koi kare us ke siva jin jin ki log parastish aur pooja karte hain woh sab baatil hain, woh tamam kainat ka ilm rakhne wala hai, jo cheezein hum par zahir hain aur jo cheezein hum se poshida hain sab us par ayan hain, khwah aasman mein ho khwah zameen mein hon khwah chhoti hon khwah bari hon yahan tak ke andheriyon ke zarre bhi us par zahir hain, woh itni bari wasee rehmat wala hai ke us ki rehmat tamam makhlooq par muheet hai, woh duniya aur aakhirat mein Rehman bhi hai aur Raheem bhi hai, hamari tafsir ke shuru mein in dono namon ki poori tafsir guzar chuki hai, Quran-e-Kareem mein aur jagah hai (tarjumah) Meri rehmat ne tamam cheezon ko gher liya hai aur jagah farman hai (tarjumah) " Tumhare Rabb ne apni zaat par rahm-o-rehmat likh li hai.

Aur farman hai (tarjuma): "Keh do keh Allah Ta'ala ke fazl o rahmat ke sath hi khush hona chahiye, tumhari jama karda cheez se behtar yahi hai."

Us Malik Rab Ma'bood ke sifa aur koi un awsaf wala nahin, tamam cheezon ka tana wahi malik-o-mukhtar hai har cheez ka her pher karne wala sab par qabza aur tasarruf rakhne wala bhi wahi hai koi nahin jo is ki muzahamat ya mudafasat kar sake ya ise mamanat kar sake, woh Quddus hai yani tahir hai, mubarak hai, zaati aur sifaati nuqsanaat se pak hai tamam buland martaba farishte aur sab ki sab aala makhlooq is ki tasbeeh-o-taqdees mein ala-ud-dawam mashghool hai kul aibon aur nuqsanaat se mubra aur munazzah hai, is ka koi kaam hikmat se khali nahin apne afaal mein bhi is ki zaat har tarah ke nuqsan se pak hai, woh Momin hai yani tamam makhlooq ko us ne is baat se be-khouf rakha hai ke un par kisi tarah ka kisi waqt apni taraf se zulm ho, us ne yeh farma kar ke yeh haq hai sab ko amn de rakha hai, apne imandar bandon ke iman ki tasdeeq karta hai, woh Muhaymin hai yani apni tamam makhlooq ke aamal ka har waqt yaksaan taur par shahid hai aur nigahban hai, jaise farman hai (tarjuma) Allah Ta'ala har cheez par shahid hai aur farman hai (tarjuma) Allah Ta'ala un ke tamam afaal par gawah hai aur jagah farmaya (tarjuma) al-akh matlab yeh hai ke har nafs jo kuch kar raha hai use Allah Ta'ala dekh raha hai, woh Aziz hai har cheez is ke tabe farman hai kul makhlooq par woh ghalib hai pas is ki izzat azmat jabroot kibriyai ki wajah se is ka muqabla koi nahi kar sakta, woh Jabbar aur Mutakabir hai, jabriyat aur kibr sirf isi ke shayan-e-shaan hai sahih hadith mein hai Allah Ta'ala farmata hai azmat mera tahmad hai aur kibriyai meri chadar hai jo mujh se in dono mein se kisi ko chheenna chahega main use azaab karunga, apni makhlooq ko jis cheez par chahe woh rakh sakta hai, kul kaamon ki islah isi ke hath hai, woh har burai se nafrat aur doori rakhne wala hai, jo log apni kam-samjhi ki wajah se doosron ko is ka shareek thehra rahe hain woh un sab se bezaar hai, is ki uloohiyat shirkat se mubra hai, Allah Ta'ala Khaliq hai yani muqaddar muqarrar karne wala, phir Baari hai yani use jari aur zahir karne wala, koi aisa nahi ke jo taqdeer aur tanqeed dono par qadir ho jo chahe andaza muqarrar kare aur phir isi ke mutabiq use chalaye bhi kabhi bhi is mein farq na aane de, bahut se tarteeb dene wale aur andaza karne wale hain jo phir ise jari karne aur isi ke mutabiq barabar jari rakhne par qadir nahi, taqdeer ke sath ایجاد aur tanqeed par bhi qudrat rakhne wali Allah ki hi zaat hai, pas khalq se murad taqdeer aur bara'a se murad tanfeed hai, arab mein yeh alfaaz in ma'non mein barabar ba-taur misaal ke bhi maruwaj hain, isi ki shaan hai ke jis cheez ko jab jis tarah karna chahe keh deta hai ke hoja woh usi tarah usi soorat mein ho jati hai jaise farman hai (tarjuma) jis soorat mein us ne chaha tujhe tarkeed di, isi liye yahan farmata hai ho Musawwir be-misl hai yani jis cheez ki ijad jis tarah ki chahta hai ke guzar-ta hai.

Pyare pyare behtareen aur buzurg tar namon wala wahi hai, Surah A'raf mein is jumla ki tafseer guzar chuki hai, niz woh hadith bhi bayan ho chuki hai jo Bukhari Muslim mein ba-riwayat Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A mavi hai ke Rasoolullah ﷺ ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala ke nnanwaye yaani ek kam ek so naam hain jo unhein shumar karle yaad rakh le woh jannat mein दाखिल (dakhil) hoga woh watar hai yaani wahid hai aur ikai ko dost rakhta hai, Tirmidhi mein un namon ki sarahat bhi ayi hai jo naam yeh hain. Ibn Majah mein bhi yeh hadith hai aur is mein kuch taqdeem taakheer kami ziyadati bhi hai al-garz un tamam ahadees waghaira ka bayan poori tarah Surah A'raf mein guzar chuka hai is liye yahan sirf itna likh dena kafi hai baqi sab ko dobara warid karne ki zaroorat nahi. Asman-o-zameen ki kul cheezein us ki tasbeeh bayan karti hain. Jaise aur jagah farman hai (tarjuma) us ki pakeezgi bayan karte hain, saton asman aur zameenen aur un mein jo makhlooq hai aur koi cheez aisi nahi jo us ki tasbeeh hamd ke sath bayan na karti ho lekin tum un ki tasbeeh ko samajh nahi sakte beshak woh burdbar aur bakhshish karne wala hai, woh Aziz hai us ki hikmat wali sarkar apne ahkam aur taqdeer ke taqaddur mein aisi nahi ke kisi tarah ki kami nikali jaye ya koi aitraz qaim kiya ja sake, Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai jo shakhs subh ko teen martaba (tarjuma) parh kar Surah Hashr ke akhir ki (in) teen ayaton ko parh le Allah Ta'ala us ke liye sattar hazar farishte muqarrar karta hai jo sham tak us par rehmat bhejte hain aur agar usi din us ka inteqal ho jaye to shahadat ka martaba pata hai aur jo shakhs un ki tilawat sham ke waqt kare woh bhi isi hukm mein hai, Tirmidhi mein bhi yeh hadith hai aur Imam Tirmidhi ؒ ise ghareeb batate hain. Alhamdulillah Surah Hashr ki tafseer khatam hui.
