Jaise aur jagah farman hai (tarjuma) us ki pakeezgi bayan karte hain, saton asman aur zameenen aur un mein jo makhlooq hai aur koi cheez aisi nahi jo us ki tasbeeh hamd ke sath bayan na karti ho lekin tum un ki tasbeeh ko samajh nahi sakte beshak woh burdbar aur bakhshish karne wala hai, woh Aziz hai us ki hikmat wali sarkar apne ahkam aur taqdeer ke taqaddur mein aisi nahi ke kisi tarah ki kami nikali jaye ya koi aitraz qaim kiya ja sake, Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai jo shakhs subh ko teen martaba (tarjuma) parh kar Surah Hashr ke akhir ki (in) teen ayaton ko parh le Allah Ta'ala us ke liye sattar hazar farishte muqarrar karta hai jo sham tak us par rehmat bhejte hain aur agar usi din us ka inteqal ho jaye to shahadat ka martaba pata hai aur jo shakhs un ki tilawat sham ke waqt kare woh bhi isi hukm mein hai, Tirmidhi mein bhi yeh hadith hai aur Imam Tirmidhi ؒ ise ghareeb batate hain. Alhamdulillah Surah Hashr ki tafseer khatam hui.

Buland-o-Azeem Martaba Quran-e-Majeed. Quran-e-Kareem ki buzurgi bayaan ho rahi hai ke fi-waqai yeh paak kitaab is qadar buland martaba hai ke dil is ke samne jhuk jayen, rongte khare hojayen, kaleje kapkapayen, is ke sachche waade aur is ki haqani dant dapt har sunne wale ko bed ki tarah thurade, aur darbar-e-Allah mein sare-e-sujood kara de, agar yeh Quran janab-e-Bari kisi sakht buland aur unche pahaar par bhi nazil farmata aur ise ghaur-o-fikr aur fehm-o-farasat ki hiss bhi deta toh woh bhi Allah ke khouf se reza reza hojata, phir insanon ke dilon par jo nisbatan bahut narm aur chhote hain, jinhein poori samajh bojh hai, is ka bahut bara asar parna chahiye, in misalon ko logon ke samne un ke ghaur-o-fikr ke liye Allah Ta'ala ne bayaan farma diya, matlab yeh hai ke insanon ko bhi dar aur aajizi chahiye, mutawatir hadith mein hai ke mimbar tayyar hone se pehle Rasool Allah ﷺ ek khajoor ke tane par tek laga kar khutba parha karte the jab mimbar ban gaya, bich gaya aur Huzoor ﷺ us par khutba parhne ko khare hue aur woh tana door hogaya, toh us mein se rane ki aawaz aane lagi aur is tarah siskiyan le le kar woh rane laga jaise koi bachcha bilak bilak kar rota ho aur ise chup karaya ja raha ho kyunke woh zikr-e-wahi ke sunne se kuch door hogaya tha. Imam Basri is hadith ko bayaan kar ke farmate the ke " Logo ek khajoor ka tana is qadar Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ka shaiq ho toh tumhe chahiye ke is se bahut zyada shauq aur chahat tum rakho. " Isi tarah ki yeh aayat hai ke " Jab ek pahaar ka yeh haal ho toh tumhe chahiye ke tum toh is halat mein is se aage raho " aur jagah farman-e-Allah hai (tarjumah) yani agar koi Quran aisa hota ke us ke bais pahaar chala diye jayen ya zameen kaat di jaye ya murde bol parin (toh us ke qabil yehi Quran tha) (magar phir bhi in kuffar ko iman naseeb na hota) aur jagah farman-e-Aali Shan hai (tarjumah) al-kh, yani baaz patthar aise hain jin mein se nahrein bah nikalti hain baaz woh hain ke phat jaate hain aur un mein se pani nikalta hai baaz Allah ke khouf se gir parte hain. Phir farmata hai Allah Ta'ala ke siva na toh koi palne aur parwarish karne wala hai, na us ke siva kisi ki aisi nishaniyan hain ke us ki kisi qism ki ibadat koi kare us ke siva jin jin ki log parastish aur pooja karte hain woh sab baatil hain, woh tamam kainat ka ilm rakhne wala hai, jo cheezein hum par zahir hain aur jo cheezein hum se poshida hain sab us par ayan hain, khwah aasman mein ho khwah zameen mein hon khwah chhoti hon khwah bari hon yahan tak ke andheriyon ke zarre bhi us par zahir hain, woh itni bari wasee rehmat wala hai ke us ki rehmat tamam makhlooq par muheet hai, woh duniya aur aakhirat mein Rehman bhi hai aur Raheem bhi hai, hamari tafsir ke shuru mein in dono namon ki poori tafsir guzar chuki hai, Quran-e-Kareem mein aur jagah hai (tarjumah) Meri rehmat ne tamam cheezon ko gher liya hai aur jagah farman hai (tarjumah) " Tumhare Rabb ne apni zaat par rahm-o-rehmat likh li hai.

Aur farman hai (tarjuma): "Keh do keh Allah Ta'ala ke fazl o rahmat ke sath hi khush hona chahiye, tumhari jama karda cheez se behtar yahi hai."

Us Malik Rab Ma'bood ke sifa aur koi un awsaf wala nahin, tamam cheezon ka tana wahi malik-o-mukhtar hai har cheez ka her pher karne wala sab par qabza aur tasarruf rakhne wala bhi wahi hai koi nahin jo is ki muzahamat ya mudafasat kar sake ya ise mamanat kar sake, woh Quddus hai yani tahir hai, mubarak hai, zaati aur sifaati nuqsanaat se pak hai tamam buland martaba farishte aur sab ki sab aala makhlooq is ki tasbeeh-o-taqdees mein ala-ud-dawam mashghool hai kul aibon aur nuqsanaat se mubra aur munazzah hai, is ka koi kaam hikmat se khali nahin apne afaal mein bhi is ki zaat har tarah ke nuqsan se pak hai, woh Momin hai yani tamam makhlooq ko us ne is baat se be-khouf rakha hai ke un par kisi tarah ka kisi waqt apni taraf se zulm ho, us ne yeh farma kar ke yeh haq hai sab ko amn de rakha hai, apne imandar bandon ke iman ki tasdeeq karta hai, woh Muhaymin hai yani apni tamam makhlooq ke aamal ka har waqt yaksaan taur par shahid hai aur nigahban hai, jaise farman hai (tarjuma) Allah Ta'ala har cheez par shahid hai aur farman hai (tarjuma) Allah Ta'ala un ke tamam afaal par gawah hai aur jagah farmaya (tarjuma) al-akh matlab yeh hai ke har nafs jo kuch kar raha hai use Allah Ta'ala dekh raha hai, woh Aziz hai har cheez is ke tabe farman hai kul makhlooq par woh ghalib hai pas is ki izzat azmat jabroot kibriyai ki wajah se is ka muqabla koi nahi kar sakta, woh Jabbar aur Mutakabir hai, jabriyat aur kibr sirf isi ke shayan-e-shaan hai sahih hadith mein hai Allah Ta'ala farmata hai azmat mera tahmad hai aur kibriyai meri chadar hai jo mujh se in dono mein se kisi ko chheenna chahega main use azaab karunga, apni makhlooq ko jis cheez par chahe woh rakh sakta hai, kul kaamon ki islah isi ke hath hai, woh har burai se nafrat aur doori rakhne wala hai, jo log apni kam-samjhi ki wajah se doosron ko is ka shareek thehra rahe hain woh un sab se bezaar hai, is ki uloohiyat shirkat se mubra hai, Allah Ta'ala Khaliq hai yani muqaddar muqarrar karne wala, phir Baari hai yani use jari aur zahir karne wala, koi aisa nahi ke jo taqdeer aur tanqeed dono par qadir ho jo chahe andaza muqarrar kare aur phir isi ke mutabiq use chalaye bhi kabhi bhi is mein farq na aane de, bahut se tarteeb dene wale aur andaza karne wale hain jo phir ise jari karne aur isi ke mutabiq barabar jari rakhne par qadir nahi, taqdeer ke sath ایجاد aur tanqeed par bhi qudrat rakhne wali be-misl hai yani jis cheez ki ijad jis tarah ki chahta hai ke guzar-ta hai.
